note: Permitted class vocabulary for typing pattern nodes: the complete class sets of the Common Core Ontologies 2.0 Artifact, Agent, Information Entity, Quality and Event modules, plus BFO 2020 core. Use the `label` value exactly as the node type. Source: CommonCoreOntology/CommonCoreOntologies commit 7a030e367a75126099a0117031c7e9ab289c2c2a.

ArtifactOntology.label: Actuator
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Transducer that is designed to convert some control signal into mechanical motion.

ArtifactOntology.label: Air Conditioning Unit
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Cooling System that is designed to remove excess heat and humidity from the air in an enclosed space.

ArtifactOntology.label: Air Inlet
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that consists of an opening that is designed to capture and direct the flow of air into the system it is part of.

ArtifactOntology.label: Air-Breathing Combustion Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Reaction Engine that functions by drawing a continuous stream of air into and through the Engine where it is compressed, mixed with a Portion of Fuel, ignited, and then expelled as exhaust gas.

ArtifactOntology.label: Air-Breathing Jet Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Jet Engine that is propelled by a jet of hot exhaust gases formed from air that is drawn into the Engine via an Air Inlet.

ArtifactOntology.label: Aircraft
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Vehicle that is designed to convey passengers, cargo, or equipment from one location to another by air travel.

ArtifactOntology.label: Alkaline Electric Battery
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Primary Cell Electric Battery that has a Zinc anode and Manganese (IV) oxide cathode.

ArtifactOntology.label: Alternating Current Power Source
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Electrical Power Source that is designed to transfer electrical power in the form of alternating current.

ArtifactOntology.label: Anti-Bacterial Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Anti-Microbial Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes harm to, or the death of, some bacterium.

ArtifactOntology.label: Anti-Microbial Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Pesticide Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes illness in, or the death of, a microorganism.

ArtifactOntology.label: Armored Fighting Vehicle
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to be armored and used to transport and support military personal in combat missions.

ArtifactOntology.label: Armored Personnel Carrier
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Armored Fighting Vehicle that is designed to transport infantry to the battlefield but which are not usually designed to take part in a direct-fire battle.

ArtifactOntology.label: Arrow
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be fired from a Bow and consists of a long straight stiff shaft with stabilizers (fletchings) and a slot (the nock) on one end and a weighted tip (the arrowhead) on the other end.

ArtifactOntology.label: Article of Clothing
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to cover some portion of a body.

ArtifactOntology.label: Article of Solid Waste
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Waste Material that has a low liquid content.

ArtifactOntology.label: Artifact Design
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that is a specification of an object, manifested by an agent, intended to accomplish goals, in a particular environment, using a set of primitive components, satisfying a set of requirements, subject to constraints.

ArtifactOntology.label: Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Function that inheres in some Material Artifact in virtue of that Material Artifact being designed to be used in processes that require that Function to be realized.

ArtifactOntology.label: Artifact Function Specification
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some Material Artifact Function and which is part of some Material Artifact Model.

ArtifactOntology.label: Artifact History
ArtifactOntology.definition: A History of a Material Artifact.

ArtifactOntology.label: Artifact Identifier
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Designative Information Content Entity which designates some Material Artifact.

ArtifactOntology.label: Artifact Location
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Site that is the location of some Material Artifact.

ArtifactOntology.label: Artifact Model
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes a common set of Functions and Qualities to inhere in a set of artifact instances.

ArtifactOntology.label: Artifact Model Name
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Designative Information Content Entity that designates some Material Artifact Model.

ArtifactOntology.label: Artificial Eye
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace a missing eye.

ArtifactOntology.label: Assault Rifle
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Rifle that is designed to have selective-fire functionality and use an intermediate Cartridge and a detachable magazine.

ArtifactOntology.label: Attitude Control Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in an attitude control process.

ArtifactOntology.label: Automobile
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to transport a small number of passengers while traveling on four tired wheels.

ArtifactOntology.label: Autopilot System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Vehicle Control System that is designed to enable some Agent to control the trajectory of a Vehicle without constant 'hands-on' control.

ArtifactOntology.label: Banknote
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Cash that consists of a portable slips of paper or fabric designed to bear some specified Financial Value.

ArtifactOntology.label: Battery Terminal
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to connect a load or charger to a single or multiple-cell Battery.

ArtifactOntology.label: Bearing Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which the Material Artifact constrains relative motion to only the desired motion, and reduces friction between moving parts.

ArtifactOntology.label: Beverage Antenna
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Wire Antenna that consists of a horizontal wire one-half to two wavelengths long that is suspended above the ground with one end attached to the receiver feedline and the other grounded and which is typically used in the low and medium frequency radio bands.

ArtifactOntology.label: Bicycle
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Ground Vehicle that consists of two wheels, one in front of the other, attached to a frame along with handlebars and pedals such that it is designed to receive its motive power from pedaling.

ArtifactOntology.label: Bidirectional Transducer
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Transducer that is designed to receive a signal in the form of physical phenomena and convert it into an electrical signal, and vice versa.

ArtifactOntology.label: Biological Weapon
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, incapacity, or death by means of releasing disease-producing agents—such as bacteria, viruses, or fungi.

ArtifactOntology.label: Bond
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Financial Instrument that is designed to secure an Agent's debt for the holders of that debt.

ArtifactOntology.label: Bond Certificate
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Bond that consists of a Certificate.

ArtifactOntology.label: Bow
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to launch Arrows.

ArtifactOntology.label: Brake
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to inhibit the Vehicle's Motion by absorbing energy from a moving system.

ArtifactOntology.label: Brake Control System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Vehicle Control System that is designed to control the process of braking with the aim of preventing rolling, skidding, and hydroplaning.

ArtifactOntology.label: Bridge
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to span physical obstacles without closing the way underneath to enable Persons or Ground Vehicles to pass over the obstacles.

ArtifactOntology.label: Bullet
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be projected by a Firearm, Sling, Slingshot, or Air Gun, but which does not (typically) contain explosives.

ArtifactOntology.label: Bus
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to transport a large number of people and to travel on six or more tired wheels.

ArtifactOntology.label: Cabin Pressurization Control System
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Environment Control System that is designed to control the process in which conditioned air is pumped into the Cabin of some Aircraft or Spacecraft in order to create a safe and comfortable environment for passengers and crew flying at high altitudes.

ArtifactOntology.label: Camera
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Imaging Instrument that is designed to form and digitally or physically record an image of an entity.

ArtifactOntology.label: Canal
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Water Transportation Artifact that is an artificial Hydrographic Feature designed to convey water or enable Watercraft to travel inland.

ArtifactOntology.label: Cannon
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to use a controlled explosion to launch a relatively large Portion of Ammunition, such as a Round Shot or a Shell, at a significant Velocity.

ArtifactOntology.label: Cargo Cabin
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Vehicle Compartment that is used to store goods or materials during transportation.

ArtifactOntology.label: Cartridge
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to package a Bullet, a propellant substance, and a primer within a case that is designed to fit within the firing chamber of a Firearm.

ArtifactOntology.label: Catadioptric Optical Telescope
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Optical Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing visible light through the use of a combination of Lenses and Mirrors to form an enhanced image of the Object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Catalyst Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the rate of a chemical reaction is increased due to the participation of an additional substance, without that substance being consumed in the reaction.

ArtifactOntology.label: Cellular Telecommunication Network
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Wireless Telecommunication Network where the last link between the network and the end user is wireless and is distributed over service areas called cells.

ArtifactOntology.label: Chemical Reaction Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process that leads to the transformation of one set of chemical substances to another.

ArtifactOntology.label: Chemical Weapon
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by means of releasing toxic chemicals.

ArtifactOntology.label: Circuit Breaker
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to protect an electrical circuit from damage caused by excess current from an overload or short circuit.

ArtifactOntology.label: Cleaning Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which some Material Artifact is used to remove foreign objects from another object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Coin
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Cash that consists of a flat, portable, round pieces of metal designed to bear some specified Financial Value.

ArtifactOntology.label: Collimation Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a collimation event in which the Material Artifact narrows a beam of particles or waves by either causing the spatial cross-section of the beam to become smaller or by causing the directions of motion of the beam's constituents to be aligned in a specifc direction of Motion.

ArtifactOntology.label: Combustion Chamber
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to wholly or partially bound an internal Site where a Combustion process is intended to occur.

ArtifactOntology.label: Combustion Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Heat Engine that is designed to convert thermal energy that is generated through a local Combustion process into mechanical energy.

ArtifactOntology.label: Common Stock
ArtifactOntology.definition: Stock that entitles its holder to voting on corporate decisions.

ArtifactOntology.label: Communication Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which one or more Information Content Entities are conveyed from one entity to another.

ArtifactOntology.label: Communication Instrument
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to facilitate communication between at least two entities.

ArtifactOntology.label: Communication Interference Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to interfere with the transmission of information for the purpose of preventing communication.

ArtifactOntology.label: Communication Reception Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process of receiving information.

ArtifactOntology.label: Communication Relay Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Communication Artifact Function that is realized in processes of first receiving and then transmitting information.

ArtifactOntology.label: Communication System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to enable some Act of Communication by means of transmission systems, relay stations, tributary stations, and data terminal equipment, usually capable of interconnection and interoperation to form an integrated whole.

ArtifactOntology.label: Communication Transmission Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process of sending information.

ArtifactOntology.label: Complex Optical Lens
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Optical Lens consisting of more than one Simple Optical Lenses.

ArtifactOntology.label: Component Role
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Role that inheres in an entity having a discrete structure in virtue of that entity being part of a system considered at a particular level of analysis.

ArtifactOntology.label: Compression Ignition Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Internal Combustion Engine that is designed to operate by igniting a portion of Fuel and Oxidizer mixture using heat generated via compression of the mixture.

ArtifactOntology.label: Compression Ignition System
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Ignition System that is designed to generate heat by compressing a portion of fuel and oxidizer mixture in order to initiate an Ignition process.

ArtifactOntology.label: Computer
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Information Processing Artifact that is designed to execute an arbitrary set of arithmetic or logical operations automatically.

ArtifactOntology.label: Computer Network
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Telecommunication Network that is designed to allow the exchange of data between two or more computers connected to the network.

ArtifactOntology.label: Computing Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a computation process.

ArtifactOntology.label: Constructed Tunnel
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Transportation Artifact that is designed to be substantially enclosed, have access constrained to portals, and to enable travel through surrounding soil, earth, or rock formation.

ArtifactOntology.label: Container
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to contain (wholly or partially) some material entity.

ArtifactOntology.label: Containing Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which one entity contains another.

ArtifactOntology.label: Control Surface
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to deflect air, water, or another medium around its surface in order to change the Attitude of a Vehicle by rotating the Vehicle on one or more of its Axes of Rotation.

ArtifactOntology.label: Control System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to manage, command, direct, or regulate the behavior of at least one other Material Artifact.

ArtifactOntology.label: Controllable Pitch Propeller
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Propeller whose blades are designed to be alterable by rotating the blades about their vertical axis by means of mechanical or hydraulic arrangement.

ArtifactOntology.label: Controlled-Access Highway
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Highway that is designed for high-speed vehicular traffic, with traffic flow and ingress/egress regulated.

ArtifactOntology.label: Convergent-Divergent Nozzle
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Nozzle that consists of a tube with an asymmetric hourglass shape that is designed to accelerate hot pressurized gas by converting the heat energy of the gas flow into kinetic energy as it passes through the Nozzle Throat to generate increased Exhaust Velocity of the gas as it exits the Nozzle.

ArtifactOntology.label: Conveyance Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Motion Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the bearer of the function conveys entities from one location to another.

ArtifactOntology.label: Cooling Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the thermal energy of a system decreases.

ArtifactOntology.label: Cooling System
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Environment Control System that is designed to cool the air or objects in a Site.

ArtifactOntology.label: Counterfeit Financial Instrument
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Counterfeit Instrument that is designed to be a fake replica of some legally sanctioned Financial Instrument.

ArtifactOntology.label: Counterfeit Instrument
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to be a fake replica of some genuine Material Artifact.

ArtifactOntology.label: Counterfeit Legal Instrument
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Counterfeit Instrument that is designed to be a fake replica of some genuine Legal Instrument.

ArtifactOntology.label: Coupling
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to connect two Shafts together at their ends for the purpose of transmitting power.

ArtifactOntology.label: Covering Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which an entity is covered.

ArtifactOntology.label: Crushing Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Damaging Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the structural integrity of an entity is impaired because of significant pressure.

ArtifactOntology.label: Cryogenic Storage Dewar
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Container that is designed to store a Portion of Cryogenic Material (such as liquid helium or liquid oxygen) and which consists of, minimally, walls that are constructed from two or more layers that are separated by a high vacuum to provide thermal insulation between the interior and exterior of the dewar.

ArtifactOntology.label: Current Conversion Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Electrical Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to convert some electrical current.

ArtifactOntology.label: Cutting Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Damaging Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the structural integrity of an entity is impaired by being opened or divided.

ArtifactOntology.label: Cutting Weapon
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by means of separating some portion of its target into two or more portions through the application of acutely directed force.

ArtifactOntology.label: Dam
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to impound surface water or underground streams.

ArtifactOntology.label: Damaging Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the structural integrity of an entity is impaired.

ArtifactOntology.label: Deception Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes which misinform or mislead some other entity.

ArtifactOntology.label: Decoy
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to distract or conceal what an individual or group might be looking for.

ArtifactOntology.label: Deflecting Prism
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Prism designed to deflect a beam of light entering the Prism by a fixed angle.

ArtifactOntology.label: Defoliant Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Herbicide Artifact Function that is realized in a process that causes a plant to lose its leaves.

ArtifactOntology.label: Denture
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace missing teeth.

ArtifactOntology.label: Designative Information Content Entity
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Information Content Entity that consists of a set of symbols that designate some Entity.

ArtifactOntology.label: Detergent Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Surfactant Artifact Function that is realized in a process that cleans substances in dilute solutions.

ArtifactOntology.label: Detonating Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes of combustion involving a supersonic exothermic front accelerating through a medium that eventually drives a shock front propagating directly in front of it.

ArtifactOntology.label: Diffraction Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a diffraction event in which the Material Artifact forces a wave to bend around the corners of an obstacle or aperture into the region of geometrical shadow of the obstacle.

ArtifactOntology.label: Diffraction Grating
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Optical Instrument with a periodic structure that is designed to split and defract a beam of light into several beams travelling in different directions.

ArtifactOntology.label: Digital Storage Device
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Information Medium Artifact that is designed to bear some Information Content Entity by means of recording that information in digital (binary) format.

ArtifactOntology.label: Dimension Specification
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Quality Specification that prescribes some Size Quality.

ArtifactOntology.label: Direct Current Power Source
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Electrical Power Source that is designed to transfer electrical power in the form of direct current.

ArtifactOntology.label: Dish Receiver
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Receiver that uses a Parabolic (or Dish) Antenna to intercept radio signals.

ArtifactOntology.label: Dispersive Prism
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Prism designed to break up a beam of light entering the Prism into its constituent spectral colors by leveraging the refractive index of light based on its Frequency.

ArtifactOntology.label: Display Instrument
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to bear an Image Display Artifact Function.

ArtifactOntology.label: Distance Measurement Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Measurement Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to measure the spatial Distance to a specified object or class of objects.

ArtifactOntology.label: Education Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of transmiting accumulated knowledge skills and values from one generation to another.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electric Battery
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Electrical Power Source that is designed to produce electric power by converting chemical energy to electrical energy.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electric Generator
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Electrical Power Source that is designed to convert mechanical energy to electrical energy for use in an external circuit.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electric Motor
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Engine that is designed to convert electrical energy into mechanical energy.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electrical Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to perform a process involving electrical power.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electrical Conduction Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Electrical Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact being used to conduct an electric current.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electrical Connector Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Electrical Conduction Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to join electrical terminations to create an electrical circuit.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electrical Contact Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Electrical Conduction Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used as an endpoint of an electrical circuit from which an electrical current is passed via physical contact with the endpoint.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electrical Power Production Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Electrical Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to generate electrical power.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electrical Power Source
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Power Source that is designed to generate, control, and transfer power in the form of electrical energy.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electrical Power Storage Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Electrical Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to store electrical power to be released at a later time.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electrical Resistance Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Electrical Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which a Material Artifact opposes the flow of an electric current.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electromagnetic Communication Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process that conveys information by means of electromagnetic radiation.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electromagnetic Induction Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact that is used to produce electromotive force across an electrical conductor due to its dynamic interaction with a magnetic field.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electromagnetic Shielding Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which an electromagnetic field is blocked by barriers made of conductive or magnetic materials.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electron Microscope
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Microscope that is designed to use a beam of accelerated electrons to illuminate the target and produce a significantly enlarged image of the Object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electronic Bond
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Bond that consists of Bytes.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electronic Cash
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Cash that consists of Bytes.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electronic Signal Processing Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Signal Processing Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to process or transfer information contained in electronic signals.

ArtifactOntology.label: Electronic Stock
ArtifactOntology.definition: Stock that consists of Bytes.

ArtifactOntology.label: Email Box
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Telecommunication Instrument that is designed to be the delivery destination of Email Messages that are addressed to the corresponding Email Address.

ArtifactOntology.label: Emergency AC/DC Power Source
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Electrical Power Source that is designed to provide electrical power in an emergency situation by means of both alternating current and direct current.

ArtifactOntology.label: Emergency Locator Transmitter
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Transmitter that is designed to signal distress and provide positional data for the entity it is located on.

ArtifactOntology.label: Emulsifier Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which two or more liquids that are normally immiscible are mixed.

ArtifactOntology.label: Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to convert one form of energy into mechanical energy.

ArtifactOntology.label: Enhancing Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes of intensifying, increainsg, or further improving the quality, value, or extent of some entity.

ArtifactOntology.label: Environment Control System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to control the temperature, air quality, or other feature of a Site that is relevant to the comfort or operation of entities located within that Site.

ArtifactOntology.label: Equipment Cooling System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Cooling System that is designed to cool some piece of equipment.

ArtifactOntology.label: Equipment Mount
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to support a Material Artifact.

ArtifactOntology.label: Explosive Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Damaging Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the structural integrity of an entity is impaired because of the rapid increase in volume and release of energy in an extreme manner.

ArtifactOntology.label: Explosive Land Mine
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Explosive Mine that is designed to be concealed under or on the ground.

ArtifactOntology.label: Explosive Mine
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Explosive Weapon that is designed to be concealed and to detonate as its target passes near it.

ArtifactOntology.label: Explosive Naval Mine
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Explosive Mine that is designed to be concealed on or under water.

ArtifactOntology.label: Explosive Weapon
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by means of a violent release of energy caused by the exothermic reaction of an explosive material.

ArtifactOntology.label: External Combustion Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Combustion Engine that is designed to have an external Combustion Chamber where portions of Fuel and Oxidizer mixture are burned to generate thermal energy to heat the working fluid, which transfers energy to the Engine where it is converted into mechanical energy.

ArtifactOntology.label: External Navigation Lighting System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Lighting System that is designed to be attached to some Vehicle and to emit colored light in order to signal that Vehicle's position, heading, and status.

ArtifactOntology.label: Facility
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed as a building or campus dedicated to some specific purpose.

ArtifactOntology.label: Fan
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that consists of a rotating arrangement of vanes or blades that are designed to act on a portion of fluid to create flow within it.

ArtifactOntology.label: Fertilizer Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Enhancing Artifact Function that is realized in processes of supplying soilds or plant tissues with one or more plant nutrients essential to growth.

ArtifactOntology.label: Filter
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that bears a Filter Function.

ArtifactOntology.label: Filter Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process where entities of a specific type or which have specified properties enter it or pass through it.

ArtifactOntology.label: Filtration Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Filter Function that is realized in a process in which some solid entity is prevented from moving along with some quantity of liquid.

ArtifactOntology.label: Financial Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of managing money.

ArtifactOntology.label: Financial Instrument
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to be a tradeable asset and that is legally sanctioned.

ArtifactOntology.label: Firearm
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to launch Bullets or Cartridges.

ArtifactOntology.label: Flight Transponder
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Transponder that is designed to produce a specified response (typically for identification, location, or status update purposes) when it receives a radio-frequency interrogation.

ArtifactOntology.label: Flow Control Valve
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Valve that is designed to regulate the flow or Pressure of a fluid.

ArtifactOntology.label: Fluid Control Artifact
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to manipulate the flow of a fluid (i.e. a liquid or a gas).

ArtifactOntology.label: Fluid Control Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which some Material Artifact is used to control the direction or flow of some fluid.

ArtifactOntology.label: Flywheel
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to store rotational energy such that it has a significant moment of inertia which enables it to resist changes in rotational speed.

ArtifactOntology.label: Fragmentation Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Damaging Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the structural integrity of an entity is impaired because of a detonation which causes fragmentation.

ArtifactOntology.label: Fragrance Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes of emitting a pleasant or sweet odor.

ArtifactOntology.label: Freight Train Car
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Train Car that is designed to transport cargo.

ArtifactOntology.label: Frequency Measurement Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Measurement Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to measure the Frequency of a specified object or class of objects.

ArtifactOntology.label: Friction Reduction Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes of reducing the force resisting the relative motion of surfaces in contact.

ArtifactOntology.label: Fuel Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which a Portion of Fuel is reacted with other substances in order to release chemical or nuclear energy to be used for heat or for work.

ArtifactOntology.label: Fuel Cell
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Electrical Power Source that consists in part of an anode, a cathode, and an electrolyte; converts chemical energy from a fuel into electricity through a chemical reaction of positively charged hydrogen ions with an oxidizing agent (typically oxygen); and, if given a continuous source of fuel and oxidizing agent, can continuously produce electricity.

ArtifactOntology.label: Fuel System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to pump, manage, and deliver some Portion of Fuel to the Propulsion System and Auxiliary Power Unit of some Vehicle.

ArtifactOntology.label: Fuel Tank
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Container that is designed to store a Portion of Fuel.

ArtifactOntology.label: Fuel Transfer System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that is designed to facilitate the transfer of some Portion of Fuel from the Fuel Tank for use in some Engine.

ArtifactOntology.label: Fuel Ventilation System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that is designed to allow air into the Fuel Tank to take the place of burned fuel.

ArtifactOntology.label: Full Motion Video Camera
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Video Camera that is designed to capture and record images of sufficiently high quality and in rapid enough succession that the resulting video supports smooth playback.

ArtifactOntology.label: Full Motion Video Imaging Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Imaging Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to produce video of entities that is of high enough quality to make the represented motion appear continuous to human viewers.

ArtifactOntology.label: Fungicide Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Anti-Microbial Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes harm to, or the death of, some fungus or fungal spore.

ArtifactOntology.label: Gamma-ray Telescope
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing Gamma-rays to form an enhanced image of the Object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Gas Turbine
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Internal Combustion Engine that has a rotating compressor and a turbine and is designed to operate utilizing continous Combustion to produce Thrust, either directly via exhaust or indirectly via a prop.

ArtifactOntology.label: Generator Control Unit
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Control System that is designed to regulate the voltage of some Electrical Power Source.

ArtifactOntology.label: Gimbal
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Equipment Mount that consists of a pivoted support that allows a Material Artifact to Rotate about one or more Axes.

ArtifactOntology.label: Government Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which public policy is administered and the actions of its members are directed.

ArtifactOntology.label: Grenade
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Explosive Weapon that is designed to be relatively small and to be thrown by hand.

ArtifactOntology.label: Ground Motor Vehicle
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Ground Vehicle that is designed to receive its motive power from an Engine and is not designed to travel on rails.

ArtifactOntology.label: Ground Moving Target Indication Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Moving Target Indication Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to identify and track entities moving on or near the ground.

ArtifactOntology.label: Ground Vehicle
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Vehicle that is designed to convey passengers, cargo, or equipment from one location to another by some form of ground travel.

ArtifactOntology.label: Hand Gun
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Firearm that is designed to have a relatively short barrel and to be held in one or two hands and to be fired without being braced against the shoulder.

ArtifactOntology.label: Healing Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which health is restored to an unbalanced, diseased, or damaged organism.

ArtifactOntology.label: Healthcare Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of treating and preventing illness.

ArtifactOntology.label: Hearing Aid
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Medical Artifact that is designed to improve hearing for its user.

ArtifactOntology.label: Heat Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Engine that is designed to convert thermal energy into mechanical energy.

ArtifactOntology.label: Heat Sink
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to regulate the temperature of a computer by the passive transfer of heat away from other components in the computer.

ArtifactOntology.label: Heating Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the thermal energy of a system increases.

ArtifactOntology.label: Heating System
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Environment Control System that is designed to heat the air or objects in a Site.

ArtifactOntology.label: Heavy Machine Gun
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Mounted Gun that is designed to fire ammunition greater than .50 caliber or 12.7mm ammunition in quick succession from an ammunition belt, and which typically weighs more than 30lbs.

ArtifactOntology.label: Helical Antenna
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Wire Antenna that consists of a conducting wire wound in the form of a helix that is typically mounted over a ground plane with a feed line connected between the bottom of the helix and the ground plane.

ArtifactOntology.label: Herbicide Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Pesticide Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes harm to, or the death to, unwanted plants.

ArtifactOntology.label: High Frequency Communication Instrument
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is designed to participate in some process that has process part some High Frequency.

ArtifactOntology.label: Highway
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Road that is designed to enable Ground Vehicles to travel on routes that connect relatively major destinations.

ArtifactOntology.label: Highway Interchange
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Road Junction that is designed to enable Ground Vehicles to exit one or more Highways and enter another Highway without directly crossing any other traffic stream.

ArtifactOntology.label: Hinge
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Machine Bearing that is designed to limit the angle of Rotation between two solid objects.

ArtifactOntology.label: Horn Antenna
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Antenna that consists of a flaring metal waveguide shaped like a horn to direct radio waves in a beam and can be used on its own or as a feeder for larger antenna structures, such as Parabolic Antennas.

ArtifactOntology.label: Hospitality Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of accommodation food and beverage meeting and events gaming entertainment and recreation tourism services and visitor information.

ArtifactOntology.label: Howitzer
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Cannon that is designed to have a relatively short barrel and to use relatively small propellant charges to propel projectiles in relatively high trajectories with a steep angle of descent.

ArtifactOntology.label: Hydraulic Fluid Reservoir
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Container that is designed to store some hydraulic fluid for use in some Hyrdraulic Power Source.

ArtifactOntology.label: Hydraulic Motor
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Physically Powered Engine that converts hydraulic pressure and flow into torque and angular displacement.

ArtifactOntology.label: Hydraulic Power Source
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Power Source that is designed to generate, control, or transmit power by means of pressurized liquid.

ArtifactOntology.label: Hydraulic Power Transfer Unit
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to transfer hydraulic power from one of an Aircraft's hydraulic systems to another in the event that a system has failed or been turned off.

ArtifactOntology.label: Hydraulic Valve
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Valve that is designed to regulate, direct, or control the flow of a liquid by opening, closing, or partially obstructing various passageways.

ArtifactOntology.label: Identification Friend or Foe Transponder
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Transponder that is designed to automatically transmit a predefined signal in response to receiving an appropriate interrogation signal such that the entity it is located on can be positively identified as friendly.

ArtifactOntology.label: Ignition System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to produce an Ignition process.

ArtifactOntology.label: Image Display Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to display an Image.

ArtifactOntology.label: Imaging Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to create one or more new Images.

ArtifactOntology.label: Imaging Instrument
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to bear an Imaging Artifact Function.

ArtifactOntology.label: Impact Shielding Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact reduces the damage caused to the shielded object by an impact with another object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Improvised Explosive Device
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Explosive Weapon that is designed to be used in non-conventional military action.

ArtifactOntology.label: Incendiary Weapon
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by means of starting a fire.

ArtifactOntology.label: Inertial Navigation System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Navigation System that is designed to continuously calculate via dead reckoning the position, orientation, and velocity of a moving object without the need for external references.

ArtifactOntology.label: Infantry Fighting Vehicle
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Armored Fighting Vehicle that is designed to carry infantry into battle and to provide fire support for them.

ArtifactOntology.label: Information Bearing Artifact
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that carries an Information Content Entity and is designed to do so using a particular format or structure.

ArtifactOntology.label: Information Bearing Entity
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Object upon which an Information Content Entity generically depends.

ArtifactOntology.label: Information Content Entity
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Generically Dependent Continuant that generically depends on some Information Bearing Entity and stands in relation of aboutness to some Entity.

ArtifactOntology.label: Information Medium Artifact
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to have some Information Bearing Artifact as part.

ArtifactOntology.label: Information Processing Artifact
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to use algorithms to transform some Information Content Entity into another Information Content Entity.

ArtifactOntology.label: Infrared Camera
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Camera that is designed to form and record an image generated from infrared radiation.

ArtifactOntology.label: Infrared Telescope
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing infrared light to form an enhanced image of the Object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Infrastructure Element
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Entity that bears an Infrastructure Role.

ArtifactOntology.label: Infrastructure Role
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Role that inheres in the bearer of a Disposition and has been assigned to an Infrastructure System such that the realization of that Disposition is sometimes part of the functioning of the Infrastructure System.

ArtifactOntology.label: Infrastructure System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Entity that is composed of elements bearing Infrastructure Roles and is by itself sufficient to provide a planned service or benefit to some organization that maintains its elements.

ArtifactOntology.label: Inhibiting Motion Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to inhibit the motion of some object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Insecticide Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Pesticide Artifact Function that is realized in a process that causes harm to, or the death of, an insect.

ArtifactOntology.label: Intercommunication System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Communication System that is designed to enable some Act of Communication between end points within a building, small collection of buildings, or within a small area of service.

ArtifactOntology.label: Interior Lighting System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Lighting System that is designed to emit light within the interior of some area.

ArtifactOntology.label: Internal Combustion Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Combustion Engine that is designed to have an internal Combustion Chamber where portions of Fuel and Oxidizer mixture are burned to generate thermal energy that is then converted into mechanical energy.

ArtifactOntology.label: Interphone
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Intercommunication System that that is designed to facilitate some Act of Communication between agents by means of audio messages.

ArtifactOntology.label: Jet Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Reaction Engine that discharges a fast moving jet that generates Thrust by jet propulsion.

ArtifactOntology.label: Land Transportation Artifact
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Transportation Artifact that facilitates the movement of Agents and Vehicles via land

ArtifactOntology.label: Landline Telephone
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Telephone that is connected to a Telephone Network through a pair of wires.

ArtifactOntology.label: Large-Scale Rocket Launcher
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Rocket Launcher that is designed to contain multiple Rocket Launchers.

ArtifactOntology.label: Laser
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to emit light coherently through a process of optical amplification based on the stimulated emission of electromagnetic radiation.

ArtifactOntology.label: Lead Acid Electric Battery
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Secondary Cell Electric Battery that has a lead anode and lead oxide cathode.

ArtifactOntology.label: Legal Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of giving legal advice to clients drafting legal documents for clients and representing clients in legal negotiations and court proceedings such as lawsuits.

ArtifactOntology.label: Legal Instrument
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed as a formally executed written document that can be formally attributed to its author, records and formally expresses a legally enforceable act, process, or contractual duty, obligation, or right, and therefore evidences that act, process, or agreement.

ArtifactOntology.label: Life Support Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact materially affects an organism, where this causes that organism to continue living in a situation where death would otherwise occur.

ArtifactOntology.label: Lifting Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to lift some object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Light Machine Gun
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Long Gun that is designed to fire bullets in quick succession from an ammunition belt or magazine and to be employed by an individual soldier, with or without assistance, and typically weighing 9-22 lbs.

ArtifactOntology.label: Lighting System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to emit light within some area.

ArtifactOntology.label: Lithium-ion Electric Battery
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Secondary Cell Electric Battery that produces electricity when lithium ions move from anode to cathode.

ArtifactOntology.label: Locomotive
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Rail Transport Vehicle that is designed to provide the motive power for a Train.

ArtifactOntology.label: Long Gun
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Firearm that is designed to have a longer barrel than a Hand Gun and to be fired while braced against the shoulder.

ArtifactOntology.label: Lubrication System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to contain, transfer, and regulate the flow of lubricant to multiple locations in a Material Artifact.

ArtifactOntology.label: Machine Bearing
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to constrain relative motion to only desired motion and reduces friction between moving parts.

ArtifactOntology.label: Manual Tool
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Tool that is designed to be powered by manual labor rather than by an engine.

ArtifactOntology.label: Mass Specification
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Quality Specification that prescribes the Amount of Mass that a Material Entity should have.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Artifact
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Entity that was designed by some Agent to realize a certain Function.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Academic Degree
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Copy of a Certificate that is issued by an Educational Organization to a Person to indicate that the Person has satisfactorily completed a course of study, or as an honorary recognition of the Person's achievement.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Barcode
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry one or more geometric shapes that concretize some Prescriptive Information Content Entity.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Book
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Copy of a Document that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity by means of ink, paper, parchment, or other materials fastened together to hinge at one side.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Certificate
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that bears an Information Content Entity which attests to certain demonstrated characteristics of an Object, Person, or Organization.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Chart
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Copy of an Image that is designed to carry some Representational Information Content Entity that is prescribed by some canonical visual format.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Code List
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Copy of a List that contains an ordered sequence of Information Bearing Entities that carry Code Identifiers.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Database
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry some set of specific Information Content Entities and to be rapidly searchable and retrievable.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Document
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity in a series of paragraphs of text or diagrams in the form of physical pieces of paper or an electronic word processor file.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Document Field
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Information Bearing Entity that is a part of some document into which carriers of prescribed information can be written or selected.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Email Message
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Copy of a Message that is transmitted to the recipient's Email Box.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Form Document
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Copy of a Document that has one or more Material Copy of a Document Field as parts in which to write or select prescribed content.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Information Line
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that consists of a single line or row of some larger Information Bearing Artifact of which it is a part.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Instrument Display Panel
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry information about some Material Artifact that is derived by the instrumentation Sensors of that Material Artifact.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Journal Article
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Copy of a Document that is designed to carry a specific brief composition on a specific topic as part of a Journal Issue.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a List
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that consists of one or more Information Bearing Artifacts that carry Information Content Entities and are the subjects of some Sequence Position Ordinality.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Message
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity that is relatively brief and to be transmitted from a sender to a recipient.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Notification Message
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Copy of a Message that is designed to carry an Information Content Entity that describes a scenario that has been determined to merit attention by the recipient.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Report
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Copy of a Document that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity that conveys an account of some event, situation, or the result of some observation or inquiry.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Spreadsheet
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Copy of a Document that is designed to carry some Information Content Entity in an interactive, tabular form.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a System Clock
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Copy of a Timekeeping Instrument that is part of a computer and is designed to issue a steady high-frequency signal that is used to synchronize all of the computer's internal components.
parents: Material Copy of a Timekeeping Instrument

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Timekeeping Instrument
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity that is about some temporal region.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Transcript
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Copy of a Document that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity that was originally recorded in a different medium.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Video
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry some specific Information Content Entity in the form of a sequence of representations that are presented sufficiently rapidly to create the appearance of motion and continuity.

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of a Warning Message
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Copy of a Notification Message that is designed to carry an Information Content Entity that describes a possible or impending threat.
parents: Material Copy of a Notification Message

ArtifactOntology.label: Material Copy of an Image
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Information Bearing Artifact that is designed to carry an Information Content Entity that represents some entity owing to a visual isomorphism between the carrying artifact and the entity.

ArtifactOntology.label: Maximum Speed Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Speed Artifact Function that is realized in some process in which the Material Artifact bearing the Artifact Function attains the highest speed at which that Material Artifact is designed to operate.

ArtifactOntology.label: Measurement Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to measure one or more features of a specified object or class of objects.

ArtifactOntology.label: Medical Artifact
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed for diagnosing, treating, or preventing disease, disability, or death.

ArtifactOntology.label: Medium Machine Gun
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Mounted Gun that is designed to fire full-power rifle Cartridges (less than .50 caliber or 12.7mm) in quick succession from an ammunition belt, and which typically weighs 22-30 lbs.

ArtifactOntology.label: Microscope
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Imaging Instrument that is designed to enable users to see Objects that are otherwise too small to be seen by the naked eye by producing a significantly enlarged image of the Object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Military Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes related to the armed services.

ArtifactOntology.label: Minimum Speed Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Speed Artifact Function that is realized in some process in which the Material Artifact bearing the Artifact Function attains the lowest speed at which that Material Artifact is designed to operate.

ArtifactOntology.label: Mirror
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Optical Instrument that is designed to reflect light that has a wavelength within a given range and is incident on its relflecting surface such that the reflected light maintains most of the characteristics of the original light.

ArtifactOntology.label: Missile Launcher
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to launch one or more Precision-Guided Missiles.

ArtifactOntology.label: Mobile Telephone
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Telephone that is connected to a Telephone Network by radio waves.

ArtifactOntology.label: Mortar
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Cannon that is designed to fire projectiles at relatively low velocities over relatively short ranges.

ArtifactOntology.label: Motion Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which an entity changes its position with respect to time.

ArtifactOntology.label: Motion Observation Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Observation Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to collect information about the Motion of a specified object or class of objects.

ArtifactOntology.label: Motorcycle
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to transport a very small number of passengers (usually 1 or 2) while traveling on two or three tired wheels.

ArtifactOntology.label: Mounted Gun
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Firearm that is designed to be fired while mounted.

ArtifactOntology.label: Moving Target Indication Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radar Imaging Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to identify and produce visual representations of moving entities by using a radar to emit successive phase coherent pulses, which are sampled and added to the subsequent pulse to cancel out signals from non-moving entities such that only signals from moving entities remain and are displayed.

ArtifactOntology.label: Navigation Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to determine the precise location of itself or another object and plan a route to a specified destination.

ArtifactOntology.label: Navigation System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to enable an Agent or Material Artifact to determine the position or direction of some object, usually for the purpose of monitoring or controlling the movement of some Vehicle from one place to another.

ArtifactOntology.label: Neutralization Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which an acid and a base react quantitatively with each other.

ArtifactOntology.label: Nickel Cadmium Electric Battery
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Secondary Cell Electric Battery that has a cadmium anode and nickel oxide hydroxide cathode.

ArtifactOntology.label: Nickel-metal Hydride Electric Battery
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Secondary Cell Electric Battery that has a metal-hydride anode and nickel oxide hydroxide cathode.

ArtifactOntology.label: Nominal Speed Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Speed Artifact Function that is realized in some process in which the Artifact bearing the Artifact Function attains a speed that does not exceed some specified tolerance of that Material Artifact.

ArtifactOntology.label: Nozzle
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that is designed to control the speed, direction, rate, shape, or pressure of the flow of fluid exiting it.

ArtifactOntology.label: Nozzle Mouth
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that consists of the portion of a Nozzle at the end that is designed to be where the flow of fluid exits the Nozzle.

ArtifactOntology.label: Nozzle Throat
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that consists of the narrowest portion of a Nozzle that is designed to converge the flow of fluid in order to increase the Velocity of the flow.

ArtifactOntology.label: Nuclear Radiation Detection Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to detect the presence of nuclear radiation particles.

ArtifactOntology.label: Nuclear Reactor
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Power Source that is designed to initiate and control a self-sustained nuclear chain reaction to produce power in the form of heat, which can be transferred to a working fluid for further conversion to mechanical or electrical energy.

ArtifactOntology.label: Nuclear Weapon
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by means of a destructive nuclear reaction, either through fission or through a combination of fission and fusion.

ArtifactOntology.label: Object Track
ArtifactOntology.definition: A One-Dimensional Spatial Region that consists of the idealized line along which an Object has traversed during some motion.

ArtifactOntology.label: Object Track Point
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Zero-Dimensional Spatial Region that is an idealized point where an Object is or was located during some motion.

ArtifactOntology.label: Observation Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to collect information about a specified object or class of objects.

ArtifactOntology.label: Ocular Prosthesis
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artificial Eye that is designed to replace a missing eye, but which does not function as an eye.

ArtifactOntology.label: Optical Camera
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Camera that is designed to form and record an image generated from visible light.

ArtifactOntology.label: Optical Communication Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Electromagnetic Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process that conveys information by means of visible light.

ArtifactOntology.label: Optical Focusing Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Optical Processing Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a light focusing event in which the Material Artifact causes the light beam to converge on a target spatial point.

ArtifactOntology.label: Optical Instrument
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to process light waves.

ArtifactOntology.label: Optical Lens
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Optical Instrument that is designed to focus or disperse a beam of light entering the lens by means of refraction.

ArtifactOntology.label: Optical Microscope
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Microscope that is designed to use visible light and a system of Optical Lenses to produce a significantly enlarged image of the Object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Optical Processing Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a visible light processing event.

ArtifactOntology.label: Optical Telescope
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing visible light to form an enhanced image of the Object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Orientation Control Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to control the Orientation of some object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Orientation Observation Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Observation Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to collect information about the Orientation of a specified object or class of objects.

ArtifactOntology.label: Oxidizer Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which electrons are removed from a reactant in a redox reaction.

ArtifactOntology.label: Parabolic Antenna
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Antenna that uses a parabolic reflector to direct or receive radio waves and has a very high gain.

ArtifactOntology.label: Part Role
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Role that inheres in an entity in virtue of it being part of some other entity without being subject to further subdivision or disassembly without destruction of its designated use.

ArtifactOntology.label: Parts List
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Quality Specification that prescribes the Amount of some type of Material Artifact that are part of or located on another Material Artifact.

ArtifactOntology.label: Passenger Train Car
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Train Car that is designed to transport passengers.

ArtifactOntology.label: Patch Antenna
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Antenna that consists of a flat rectangular sheet (or patch) of metal mounted over a larger sheet of metal called a ground plane which is typically contained inside a plastic radome for protection and is small enough that it can be mounted on a flat surface.

ArtifactOntology.label: Patch Receiver
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Receiver that uses a Patch Antenna to intercept radio signals.

ArtifactOntology.label: Payload
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Entity that is transported by a Vehicle during an Act of Location Change for the purpose of being delivered to or performing one or more functions at a predefined location.

ArtifactOntology.label: Payload Capacity
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that inheres in a Vehicle that is designed to transport Payload, and which is typically characterized by the maximum Weight, Mass, or Volume of Payload that the Vehicle can transport.

ArtifactOntology.label: Periscope
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Optical Instrument that is designed to enable observation of an object that is located over, around, or through another object, obstacle, or condition that prevents direct line-of-sight observation from the observer's current position.

ArtifactOntology.label: Pesticide Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Poison Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes illness in, or the death of, a living thing that is detrimental to humans or human concerns.

ArtifactOntology.label: Physically Powered Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Engine that is designed to convert potential or kinetic energy into mechanical energy.

ArtifactOntology.label: Pneumatic Motor
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Physically Powered Engine that converts potential energy stored in a portion of compressed air into mechanical energy.

ArtifactOntology.label: Pneumatic Power Source
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Power Source that is designed to generate, control, or transmit power by means of compressed air or compressed inert gases.

ArtifactOntology.label: Poison Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Damaging Artifact Function that is realized in a process which causes illness in, or the death of, a living thing.

ArtifactOntology.label: Polarizing Prism
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Prism designed to split a beam of light entering the Prism into components of varying polarization.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Ammunition
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by being projected toward its target at a significant Velocity.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Cash
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Financial Instrument that is designed to be a ready medium of exchange.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Coolant
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Material that is designed to be used in a thermal control system to reduce or maintain the temperature of an object to or at a specified level.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Cryogenic Material
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Material that has been reduced to a very low temperature (below -180 degrees Celcius).

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Food
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Processed Material that is designed to be consumed and ingested for nutrition or taste.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Fuel
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Material that is designed to release thermal energy when reacted with other substances.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Gallium Arsenide
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Material that is composed of a compound of the elements gallium and arsenic.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Gaseous Fuel
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Fuel that is stored in a gaseous state.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Gaseous Propellant
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Propellant that is stored in a gaseous state.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Gelatinous Propellant
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Propellant that is stored in a gelatinous state.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Geosphere
ArtifactOntology.definition: A fiat object part that is composed of one or more portions of the atmosphere, cryosphere, hydrosphere, or lithosphere.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Liquid Fuel
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Fuel that is stored in a liquid state.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Liquid Helium
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Cryogenic Material that is composed (almost) entirely of liquid helium.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Liquid Hydrogen
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Cryogenic Material that is composed (almost) entirely of liquid hydrogen.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Liquid Nitrogen
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Cryogenic Material that is composed (almost) entirely of liquid nitrogen.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Liquid Oxygen
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Cryogenic Material that is composed (almost) entirely of liquid oxygen.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Liquid Propellant
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Propellant that is stored in a liquid state.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Material
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Processed Material that was produced to be used as the input for another Act of Material Artifact Processing.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Nuclear Fuel
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Material that is designed to be used in a nuclear fission process to produce energy.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Oxidizer
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Material that is disposed to steal electrons from other substances (i.e. to oxidize other substances) as a participant in a reduction-oxidation process.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Paper
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Information Medium Artifact that is designed to bear some Information Content Entity by means of pressing together moist fibres of cellulose pulp derived from wood, rags, or grasses, and drying them into flexible sheets.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Processed Material
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is the output of an Act of Material Artifact Processing.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Propellant
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Material that is designed to be used as an input in a Propulsion Process to produce Thrust.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Solid Fuel
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Fuel that is stored in a solid state.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Solid Propellant
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Propellant that is stored in a solid state.

ArtifactOntology.label: Portion of Waste Material
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Processed Material that serves no further use in terms of the initial user's own purposes of production, transformation, or consumption such that the Agent wants to dispose of it.

ArtifactOntology.label: Position Observation Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Observation Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to collect information about the position of a specified object or class of objects.

ArtifactOntology.label: Power Inverting Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Current Conversion Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to convert direct current (DC) to alternating current (AC).

ArtifactOntology.label: Power Rectifier
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to convert alternating current (AC) to direct current (DC).

ArtifactOntology.label: Power Rectifying Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Current Conversion Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to convert alternating current (AC) to direct current (DC).

ArtifactOntology.label: Power Source
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to supply power to some other Material Artifact.

ArtifactOntology.label: Power Tool
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Tool that is designed to be actuated by a Power Source and mechanism other than or in addition to manual labor.

ArtifactOntology.label: Power Transformer
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to transfer electrical energy between two or more circuits through electromagnetic induction.

ArtifactOntology.label: Power Transformer Rectifier Unit
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to perform the functions of both a Rectifier and a Transformer.

ArtifactOntology.label: Power Transmission Artifact
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to transfer and regulate Power flow from a Power Source to an application point.
