ArtifactOntology.label: Powering Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to supply power to some Material Artifact.

ArtifactOntology.label: Precision-Guided Missile
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be a self-propelled and precision-guided projectile that delivers some payload (explosive or other) over relatively long distances.

ArtifactOntology.label: Preferred Stock
ArtifactOntology.definition: Stock that entitles its holder to receive a certain level of dividend payments before any dividends can be issued to other holders.

ArtifactOntology.label: Prescriptive Information Content Entity
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Information Content Entity that prescribes some Entity.

ArtifactOntology.label: Pressurization Control Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Ventilation Control Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to control the partial pressure of air in some space.

ArtifactOntology.label: Primary Cell Electric Battery
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Electric Battery that is designed for one-time use and not to be recharged.

ArtifactOntology.label: Prism
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Optical Instrument that is designed to refract light and which consists of a transparent material with flat polished surfaces where at least two of these surfaces have an angle between them.

ArtifactOntology.label: Projectile Launcher
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict damage or harm by means of launching a high-velocity projectile at a target.

ArtifactOntology.label: Propeller
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to convert rotary motion from an Engine or other mechanical Power Source into propulsive Force.

ArtifactOntology.label: Propelling Nozzle
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Nozzle that is used to convert a propulsion Engine into a Jet Engine and functions by using its narrowest part, the throat, to increase Pressure within the Engine by constricting flow, usually until the flow chokes, then expanding the exhaust stream to, or near to, atmospheric pressure, while forming it into a high speed jet to propel the Vehicle.

ArtifactOntology.label: Propulsion Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Motion Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which the bearer of the function creates force leading to an entity's movement.

ArtifactOntology.label: Propulsion Control System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Control System that consists of control devices, displays, indicators, or modules designed to control a Propulsion System.

ArtifactOntology.label: Propulsion System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to facilitate the movement of material entities from one location to another and which consists of a source of mechanical power and a means of converting this power into propulsive force to generate the movement.

ArtifactOntology.label: Prosthesis
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Medical Artifact that is designed to replace a missing body part.

ArtifactOntology.label: Prosthetic Arm
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace a missing arm.

ArtifactOntology.label: Prosthetic Foot
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace a missing foot.

ArtifactOntology.label: Prosthetic Hand
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace a missing hand.

ArtifactOntology.label: Prosthetic Leg
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Prosthesis that is designed to replace a missing leg.

ArtifactOntology.label: Public Address System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Communication System that is designed to allow a Person to speak to a large audience.

ArtifactOntology.label: Public Safety Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of preventing and responding to events that could endanger the safety of the general public from significant danger, injury/harm, or damage, such as crimes or disasters (natural or man-made).

ArtifactOntology.label: Pulsejet Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that is capable of operating statically and uses intermittent (pulsing) Combustion of the fuel-oxidizer mixture before expelling the exhaust out through the rear Propelling Nozzle to generate Thrust.

ArtifactOntology.label: Pump
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that is designed to impart motion to a portion of fluid to transport it within a system through the use of mechanical action.

ArtifactOntology.label: Quality Specification
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some Quality.

ArtifactOntology.label: Radar Imaging Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Imaging Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to produce visual representations of entities using radio waves.

ArtifactOntology.label: Radio Antenna
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Bidirectional Transducer that is designed to convert electric power into radio waves, and radio waves into electric power.

ArtifactOntology.label: Radio Communication Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Electromagnetic Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process that conveys information by means of radio waves.

ArtifactOntology.label: Radio Communication Instrument
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Communication Instrument that is designed to enable communication between two or more entities via the use of radio waves.

ArtifactOntology.label: Radio Communication Interference Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Communication Interference Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to interfere with the transmission of information via radio waves.

ArtifactOntology.label: Radio Communication Reception Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Communication Reception Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact receives information transmitted from another Material Artifact, where the transmission of information occurs using radio waves.

ArtifactOntology.label: Radio Communication Relay Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Communication Relay Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to first receive and then transmit information without the use of wires from one Material Artifact to another for the purpose of communiction.

ArtifactOntology.label: Radio Receiver
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is an electronic device that is designed to extract information from radio waves intercepted by a Radio Antenna by using electronic filters to separate the desired radio frequency signal from other signals, an electronic amplifier to increase the power of the signal, and demodulation to recover the desired information.

ArtifactOntology.label: Radio Repeater
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Transceiver that is designed to receive a radio signal, amplify it, and retransmit it (often on another frequency).

ArtifactOntology.label: Radio Telescope
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing radio waves to form an enhanced image of the Object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Radio Transceiver
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is an electronic device composed of both a Radio Transmitter and a Radio Receiver that share common circuitry or a single housing.

ArtifactOntology.label: Radio Transmitter
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is an electronic device that is designed to generate a radio frequency alternating current, which can be applied to a Radio Antenna to be transmitted as radio waves.

ArtifactOntology.label: Radio Transponder
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is an electronic device that acts as both a Radio Transmitter and responder and is used to wirelessly receive and transmit electrical signals.

ArtifactOntology.label: Radio Wave Conversion Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact being used to convert electric power into radio waves or radio waves into electric power.

ArtifactOntology.label: Radiological Weapon
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Weapon that is designed to inflict harm, damage, or incapacity by means of releasing radioactive material.

ArtifactOntology.label: Rail Transport Vehicle
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Ground Vehicle that is designed to convey cargo, passengers, or equipment by Railway.

ArtifactOntology.label: Railcar
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Rail Transport Vehicle that consists of a single self-propelled Vehicle that is not a Train, is designed to transport passengers, and which may also be designed to connect to other Railcars to form a Train.

ArtifactOntology.label: Railway
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable Trains to transport passengers and goods.

ArtifactOntology.label: Railway Crossing
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable Persons or Ground Vehicles to cross a Railway when traveling along a road or path that is perpendicular to and at the same elevation as the Railway at the point where they overlap.

ArtifactOntology.label: Railway Junction
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable a Train to switch between the tracks of two routes.

ArtifactOntology.label: Ramjet Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that uses the forward motion of the Engine to compress incoming air (without the use of an axial compressor) and decelerate it to subsonic speeds before adding the fuel and constantly combusting the mixture then expelling the exhaust out through the rear Propelling Nozzle to generate Thrust.

ArtifactOntology.label: Random Wire Antenna
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Wire Antenna that consists of a long wire suspended above the ground with a length that does not bear a relation to the wavelength of the radio waves used and which is typically used as a receiving antenna on the long, medium, and short wave bands.

ArtifactOntology.label: Reactant Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in a process in which a substance or compound is added to a system in order to bring about a chemical reaction and is consumed in the course of the reaction.

ArtifactOntology.label: Reaction Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Engine that provides propulsion by expelling Reaction Mass.

ArtifactOntology.label: Reaction Mass
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Entity against which a Propulsion System operates in order to produce Acceleration.

ArtifactOntology.label: Reciprocating Steam Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Steam Engine that is designed to use one or more reciprocating pistons to convert pressure into a rotating motion.

ArtifactOntology.label: Recording Device
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Information Processing Artifact that is designed to capture some information and store it in some recording format on some storage medium.

ArtifactOntology.label: Reflecting Optical Telescope
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Optical Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing visible light via reflection through the use of one or more curved Mirrors to form an enhanced image of the Object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Reflection Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a reflection event in which the Material Artifact causes a change in a wavefront at an interface between the reflecting medium and the transmission medium such that the wavefront returns into the transmission medium.

ArtifactOntology.label: Reflective Prism
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Prism designed to reflect light in order to flip, invert, rotate, deviate, or displace a beam of light entering the Prism.

ArtifactOntology.label: Refracting Optical Telescope
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Optical Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing visible light via refraction through the use of one or more Lenses to form an enhanced image of the Object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Refraction Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact participating in a refraction event in which the Material Artifact causes a change in direction of wave propagation due to a change in its transmission medium.

ArtifactOntology.label: Religious Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes related to worship and prayer.

ArtifactOntology.label: Research Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to perform research on a specified entity or class of entities.

ArtifactOntology.label: Research and Development Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of producing new knowledge or of devising new applications of existing knowledge.

ArtifactOntology.label: Residential Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of residing in a dwelling or home.

ArtifactOntology.label: Resource
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Continuant that is owned by, in the possession of, or is otherwise controlled by an Agent such that it could be used by that Agent.

ArtifactOntology.label: Retail Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of selling goods or merchandise in small or individual lots for direct consumption by persons or organizations.

ArtifactOntology.label: Revolver
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Hand Gun having a number of firing chambers in a revolving cylinder, where each chamber in the cylinder can be loaded with a single Cartridge.

ArtifactOntology.label: Rhombic Antenna
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Wire Antenna that consists of one to three parallel wires suspended above the ground by poles or towers at each vertex in a rhombic shape with each of the four sides being the same length (typically at least one wavelength or longer).

ArtifactOntology.label: Rifle
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Long Gun that is designed to have a rifled barrel and to fire single Bullets over long ranges with high accuracy.

ArtifactOntology.label: Road
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable Ground Vehicles to travel from one location to another.

ArtifactOntology.label: Road Junction
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable Ground Vehicles to exit one Road and enter another.

ArtifactOntology.label: Rocket
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Vehicle that is designed to travel through air or space and which obtains Thrust from a Rocket Engine.

ArtifactOntology.label: Rocket Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Jet Engine that is designed to use only stored Rocket Propellant to form a high speed propulsive jet in order to generate Thrust.

ArtifactOntology.label: Rocket Launcher
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to launch one or more Unguided Rockets.

ArtifactOntology.label: Rocket Pod
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Rocket Launcher that is designed to contain several Unguided Rockets held in individual tubes and to be used by Aircraft or Helicopters for close air support.

ArtifactOntology.label: Rocket-Propelled Grenade
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Unguided Rocket that is designed to contain an explosive warhead, be fired from a Shoulder-Fired Rocket Launcher, and be used against Tanks.

ArtifactOntology.label: Round Shot
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be a solid projectile without explosive charge and to be fired from a cannon.

ArtifactOntology.label: Satellite Artifact
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Spacecraft that is designed to Orbit a Space Object (typically Earth).

ArtifactOntology.label: Scramjet Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that uses the forward motion of the Engine to compress incoming air at supersonic speeds before adding the fuel and constantly combusting the mixture then expelling the exhaust out through the rear Propelling Nozzle to generate Thrust.

ArtifactOntology.label: Secondary Cell Electric Battery
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Electric Battery that is designed to be recharged.

ArtifactOntology.label: Semi-automatic Pistol
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Hand Gun that has a single fixed firing chamber machined into the rear of the barrel and an ammunition magazine capable of holding multiple Cartridges such that the Hand Gun is designed to automatically reload each time it is fired and to fire a Bullet with each successive pull of the trigger until the stored ammunition is depleted.

ArtifactOntology.label: Sensing Process
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Process that realizes a Sensor Function or Sensor Role.

ArtifactOntology.label: Sensor
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Entity that bears a Sensor Function or Sensor Role.

ArtifactOntology.label: Sensor Deployment Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to support or convey one or more Sensors while the Sensors are realizing their own Artifact Functions.

ArtifactOntology.label: Sensor Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Function that is realized in processes wherein an attribute of its bearer is a proxy for some aspect of its sensing environment.

ArtifactOntology.label: Sensor Platform
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Entity that bears a Sensor Platform Artifact Function or Sensor Platform Role.

ArtifactOntology.label: Sensor Platform Role
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Role that inheres in an entity in virtue of it being used to support or convey a Sensor during its deployment and functioning.

ArtifactOntology.label: Sensor Role
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Role that inheres in an entity in virtue of it being used in a process wherein an attribute of its bearer acts as a proxy for some aspect of its sensing environment.

ArtifactOntology.label: Service Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process of providing intangible goods to consumers.

ArtifactOntology.label: Shaft
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to rotate and transmit Torque, Power, or Rotational Motion from one machine element to another.

ArtifactOntology.label: Shell
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be a non-self-propelled projectile and to carry a payload (explosive or other) over a relatively short distance.

ArtifactOntology.label: Shotgun
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Long Gun that fires packets of shot, a single slug, a sabot, or a specialty round (such as tear gas, bolo shell, or a breaching round) over shorter ranges than that of Rifles and with less accuracy.

ArtifactOntology.label: Shoulder-Fired Rocket Launcher
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Rocket Launcher that is designed to be small enough to be carried by a single person and fired while supported on the person's shoulder.

ArtifactOntology.label: Signal Detection Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in the process of discerning between information-bearing patterns and random patterns, or noise, that distract from the information.

ArtifactOntology.label: Signal Processing Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in the process of transferring or processing information contained in signals.

ArtifactOntology.label: Simple Optical Lens
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Optical Lens consisting of a single piece of transparent material.

ArtifactOntology.label: Sniper Rifle
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Rifle that is designed to be highly accurate for long-range precision tactical shooting.

ArtifactOntology.label: Solar Panel
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Electrical Power Source that consists in part of one or more photovoltaic (i.e. solar) cells that convert light energy (photons) directly into electricity by means of the photovoltaic effect.

ArtifactOntology.label: Solar Panel System
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Electrical Power Source that consists in part of one or more Solar Panels, a power inverter, electrical wiring between the components, a mounting and support structure, and may also include a battery and/or a solar tracking system and is the bearer of functions realized in processes of deriving, transferring, and storing electrical energy derived from light energy.

ArtifactOntology.label: Solvent Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Chemical Reaction Artifact Function that is realized in the dissolving of other substances (namely, solutes) without change in the former's chemical structure.

ArtifactOntology.label: Spacecraft
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Vehicle that is designed to convey passengers, cargo, or equipment from one location to another by Spaceflight.

ArtifactOntology.label: Spark Ignition Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Internal Combustion Engine that is designed to operate by generating a spark to ignite a portion of Fuel and Oxidizer mixture.

ArtifactOntology.label: Spark Ignition System
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Ignition System that is designed to produce a spark in order to initiate an Ignition process.

ArtifactOntology.label: Speed Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Motion Artifact Function that is realized in some process in which its bearer has some speed.

ArtifactOntology.label: Speed Measurement Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Measurement Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to measure the Speed of a specified object's or class of objects' Motion.

ArtifactOntology.label: Spray Nozzle
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Nozzle that is designed to facilitate a conversion of the flow of a portion of liquid into a dynamic collection of drops dispersed in a portion of gas.

ArtifactOntology.label: Steam Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: An External Combustion Engine that is designed to use steam as its working fluid.

ArtifactOntology.label: Steering Control System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Vehicle Control System that is designed to control the direction some Vehicle is traveling.

ArtifactOntology.label: Stirling Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: An External Combusion Engine that is designed to compress and expand some working fluid at different temperatures, such that there is a net conversion of heat energy to mechanical work.

ArtifactOntology.label: Stock
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Financial Instrument that entitles holders to an ownership interest (equity) in the specified Incorporated Organization.

ArtifactOntology.label: Stock Certificate
ArtifactOntology.definition: Stock that consists of a Certificate.

ArtifactOntology.label: Structural Support Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact providing physical support to another object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Submachine Gun
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Long Gun that is designed to be have automatic-fire functionality, fire pistol-caliber ammunition that is magazine-fed, and which is usually smaller than other automatic firearms.

ArtifactOntology.label: Submersible Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes of operating while submerged in water.

ArtifactOntology.label: Submillimeter Wavelength Radio Telescope
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing radio waves from the submillimeter waveband (i.e. microwaves) to form an enhanced image of the Object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Surfactant Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Emulsifier Artifact Function that is realized in a process that lowers the surface tension between two liquids or between a liquid and a solid.

ArtifactOntology.label: Switch Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in a process of breaking an electric circuit by interrupting the current or diverting it from one conductor to another.

ArtifactOntology.label: Synthetic Aperture Radar Imaging Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radar Imaging Artifact Function that inheres in Material Artifacts that are designed to produce visual representations of entities using the motion of a radar antenna over a targeted region to create a synthetic aperture.

ArtifactOntology.label: System Role
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Role that inheres in an entity in virtue of its parts or elements being arranged in such a way that they together exhibit behavior or meaning that they do not exhibit individually.

ArtifactOntology.label: Tank
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Armored Fighting Vehicle that is designed to carry heavy firepower, have a powerful Engine, and travel on one or more continuous tracks such that it is suitable for front-line combat and can provide operational maneuverability as well as tactical offensive and defensive capabilities.

ArtifactOntology.label: Telecommunication Endpoint
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Telecommunication Network Node that connects a Telecommunication Terminal to a Telecommunication Network.

ArtifactOntology.label: Telecommunication Infrastructure
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Infrastructure System that is designed to support the use of Telecommunication Instruments to communicate.

ArtifactOntology.label: Telecommunication Instrument
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Communication Instrument that is designed for use by some Agent in some Act of Communication where the recipient of that communication is potentially a significant distance away from the Agent.

ArtifactOntology.label: Telecommunication Network
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Communication System that is designed to enable the transmission of information over significant distances between Telecommunication Endpoints via Telecommunication Network Nodes and Lines.

ArtifactOntology.label: Telecommunication Network Line
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Communication Artifact that is designed to be the physical transmission medium that connects two or more Telecommunication Network Nodes within a Telecommunication Network to facilitate communication between the Nodes.

ArtifactOntology.label: Telecommunication Network Node
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Communication Artifact that consists of a connection point, redistribution point, or endpoint that is designed to be part of a Telecommunication Network and can be either active or passive.

ArtifactOntology.label: Telecommunication Switching Node
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Telecommunication Network Node that is capable of redirecting a communication transmission to another Telecommunication Network Node.

ArtifactOntology.label: Telephone
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Telecommunication Instrument that is designed to provide point-to-point communication between agents by means of audio messages.

ArtifactOntology.label: Telephone Line
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Telecommunication Network Line that consists of a physical wire or other signaling medium that is designed to be part of a Telephone Network.

ArtifactOntology.label: Telephone Network
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Telecommunication Network that is designed to allow telephone calls to be made between two or more parties connected to the network.

ArtifactOntology.label: Telephone Subscriber Line
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Telephone Line that connects a Communication Endpoint to another node in a Telecommunication Network to enable service to a user's Telephone.

ArtifactOntology.label: Telescope
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Imaging Instrument that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing Electromagnetic Radiation to form an enhanced image of the Object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Temperature Measurement Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Measurement Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to measure the Temperature of a specified object or class of objects.

ArtifactOntology.label: Terminal Board
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to join electrical terminations and create an electrical circuit by means of a block which connects individual wires without a splice or physically joining the ends.

ArtifactOntology.label: Thermal Control Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by a Material Artifact increasing, decreasing, or maintaining the temperature of itself, a part of itself, or another object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Thermal Imaging Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Imaging Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to create a visual representation of an entity using radiation from the far infrared region of the electromagnetic spectrum that the entity emits

ArtifactOntology.label: Thermal Insulation Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Thermal Control Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact prevents or reduces the transfer of heat between objects that are in thermal contact or in range of radiative influence.

ArtifactOntology.label: Timekeeping Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to keep track of and report the current time.

ArtifactOntology.label: Title Document
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Legal Instrument that is designed as evidence of ownership.

ArtifactOntology.label: Tool
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to assist in the performance of manual or mechanical work and not to be consumed in that process.

ArtifactOntology.label: Torpedo
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Precision-Guided Missile that is designed to be fired into a body of water, be self-propelled through the water, and carry an explosive payload.

ArtifactOntology.label: Torpedo Tube
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Projectile Launcher that is designed to launch Torpedoes.

ArtifactOntology.label: Trail
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Land Transportation Artifact that is designed to enable transport through rough country, such as a forest or moor.

ArtifactOntology.label: Train
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Rail Transport Vehicle that consists of a series of connected Train Cars or Railcars.

ArtifactOntology.label: Train Car
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Rail Transport Vehicle that consists of a single Vehicle that is not a Train but is designed to be connected to other Train Cars along with at least one Locomotive to form a Train.

ArtifactOntology.label: Transducer
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to convert one form of energy to another.

ArtifactOntology.label: Transportation Artifact
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is fixed in place and designed to enable the movement of Vehicles and Agents from one location to another.

ArtifactOntology.label: Transportation Infrastructure
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Infrastructure System that has continuant part one or more Transportation Artifacts and bears a function that, if realized, is realized in Acts of Cargo Transportation

ArtifactOntology.label: Trim Tab
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Control Surface that is designed to counteract hydro-, aerodynamic, or other forces in order to stabilize the Vehicle it is part of in the desired Attitude.

ArtifactOntology.label: Triple Inertial Navigation System
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Inertial Navigation System that is designed to use three redundant computers to continuously calculate via dead reckoning the position, orientation, and velocity of a moving object without the need for external references, in such a way that eliminates the need for a navigator.

ArtifactOntology.label: Tripod
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that consists of three legs and a platform that joins them and which is designed to support the weight and maintain the stability of objects that are attached to or rested on the platform.

ArtifactOntology.label: Truck
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Ground Motor Vehicle that is designed to be used to transport cargo.

ArtifactOntology.label: Turbine Steam Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Steam Engine that is designed to extract thermal energy from pressurized steam and use it to do mechanical work on a rotating output shaft.

ArtifactOntology.label: Turbofan Air-Breathing Jet Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that uses a Turbofan, which consists of a Turbine and a Fan.

ArtifactOntology.label: Turbojet Air-Breathing Jet Engine
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Air-Breathing Jet Engine that uses a Turbojet, which consists of a Turbine with a Propelling Nozzle.

ArtifactOntology.label: Ultra High Frequency Communication Instrument
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is designed to participate in some process that has process part some Ultra High Frequency.

ArtifactOntology.label: Ultraviolet Telescope
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing ultraviolet light to form an enhanced image of the Object.

ArtifactOntology.label: Unguided Rocket
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Portion of Ammunition that is designed to be a self-propelled, but unguided, projectile that delivers some payload (explosive or other) over relatively long distances through the use of a Rocket Engine.

ArtifactOntology.label: Valve
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Fluid Control Artifact that is designed to regulate, direct, or control the flow of fluid by opening, closing, or partially obstructing the fluid from moving along a passageway.

ArtifactOntology.label: Vehicle
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to facilitate the movement of material entities from one location to another by conveying them there.

ArtifactOntology.label: Vehicle Compartment
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to partition a Vehicle into subdivisions for various purposes.

ArtifactOntology.label: Vehicle Control System
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Control System that is designed to enable some Agent to control some Vehicle.

ArtifactOntology.label: Vehicle Frame
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to be the main supporting structure of some Vehicle.

ArtifactOntology.label: Vehicle Track
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Object Track for a Vehicle during some motion.

ArtifactOntology.label: Vehicle Track Point
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Object Track Point that is where a Vehicle is or was located during some motion.

ArtifactOntology.label: Vehicle Transmission
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Power Transmission Artifact that is designed to vary the output speed and torque in a rotating power transfer system.

ArtifactOntology.label: Ventilation Control Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized in processes in which some Material Artifact is used to control the quality of air in some space.

ArtifactOntology.label: Very High Frequency Communication Instrument
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Communication Instrument that is designed to participate in some process that has process part some Very High Frequency.

ArtifactOntology.label: Video Camera
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Camera that is designed to form and digitally or physically record a continuous stream of subsequent images of an entity or scene such that the images can be played back in succession as a video.

ArtifactOntology.label: Visual Prosthesis
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artificial Eye that is designed to replace a missing eye, which performs the function of an eye.

ArtifactOntology.label: Voltage Regulating Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: An Artifact Function that is realized by processes in which some Material Artifact is used to cause a change in the voltage magnitude between the sending and receiving end of an electrical component.

ArtifactOntology.label: Waste Management Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Service Artifact Function that is realized in processes of collecting, transporting, processing, recycling, monitoring, or disposing of waste materials.

ArtifactOntology.label: Water Transportation Artifact
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Transportation Artifact that facilitates the movement of Agents and Vehicles via water.

ArtifactOntology.label: Watercraft
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Vehicle that is designed to convey passengers, cargo, or equipment from one location to another by water travel.

ArtifactOntology.label: Weapon
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Material Artifact that is designed to destroy or inflict damage to structures or systems, or to kill or wound living things by creating specific lethal or nonlethal effects.

ArtifactOntology.label: Wetting Agent Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Surfactant Artifact Function that is realized in a process that reduces the water repellent tendency of a substance thereby allowing it to become wet.

ArtifactOntology.label: Wire Antenna
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Antenna that consists primarily of a length of wire.

ArtifactOntology.label: Wire Receiver
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Radio Receiver that uses a Wire Antenna to intercept radio signals.

ArtifactOntology.label: Wired Communication Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Communication Artifact Function that is realized in a process that conveys meaningful signs by means of a (usually cylindrical) flexible strand or rod of metal.

ArtifactOntology.label: Wired Communication Reception Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Communication Reception Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact receives information transmitted from another Material Artifact, where the transmission of information occurs via a direct connection using an electrical conductor.

ArtifactOntology.label: Wired Communication Relay Artifact Function
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Communication Relay Artifact Function that is realized during events in which a Material Artifact is used to first receive and then transmit information by means of wires from one Material Artifact to another for the purpose of communiction.

ArtifactOntology.label: Wireless Telecommunication Network
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Telecommunication Network that uses wireless connections to connect Telecommunication Network Nodes.

ArtifactOntology.label: X-ray Microscope
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Microscope that is designed to use Electromagnetic Radiation in the soft X-ray band to produce a significantly enlarged image of the Object.

ArtifactOntology.label: X-ray Telescope
ArtifactOntology.definition: A Telescope that is designed to aid in the observation of spatially distant Objects by means of collecting and focusing X-rays to form an enhanced image of the Object.

AgentOntology.label: Action Permission
AgentOntology.definition: A Process Regulation that permits some Process.

AgentOntology.label: Affordance
AgentOntology.definition: A Realizable Entity of an Independent Continuant that creates an opportunity for an Agent to realize some Agent Capability or Disposition in some Act.

AgentOntology.label: Agent
AgentOntology.definition: A Material Entity that bears an Agent Capability.

AgentOntology.label: Agent Capability
AgentOntology.definition: A Realizable Entity that inheres in a Material Entity in virtue of that Material Entity's capacity to realize it in some Planned Act.

AgentOntology.label: Allegiance Role
AgentOntology.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of the support it has committed to provide to another Agent when that Agent is involved in a conflict.

AgentOntology.label: Allied Person
AgentOntology.definition: A Person who is the bearer of some Ally Role.

AgentOntology.label: Ally Role
AgentOntology.definition: An Allegiance Role that inheres in an Agent in virtue of that Agent's commitment to perform Acts that support the Objectives of a particular Agent or Group of Agents.

AgentOntology.label: Animal
AgentOntology.definition: An Organism that is multicellular, eukaryotic, heterotrophic, and capable of motility for part of its life.

AgentOntology.label: Armed Force
AgentOntology.definition: An Organization having the Objective to further the foreign and domestic policies of a Government and to defend that body and the nation it represents from external and internal aggressors.

AgentOntology.label: Authority Role
AgentOntology.definition: A Role that is realized by Processes which create, modify, transfer, or eliminate Process Regulations or other Authority Roles, and inheres in an Agent in virtue of collective acceptance of that Agent's ability to issue binding directives.

AgentOntology.label: Biological Sex
AgentOntology.definition: A Quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to undergo sexual reproduction in order to differentiate the individuals or types involved.

AgentOntology.label: Bodily Component
AgentOntology.definition: A Fiat Object Part located within or on the surface of an Agent.

AgentOntology.label: Carrier Air Wing
AgentOntology.definition: A Military Force that is trained and equipped to conduct air operations while embarked on an aircraft carrier.

AgentOntology.label: Citizen
AgentOntology.definition: A Person who is the bearer of some Citizen Role.

AgentOntology.label: Citizen Role
AgentOntology.definition: A Role that inheres in a Person by virtue of that Person being legally recognized as a member of a particular state, with associated rights and obligations.

AgentOntology.label: City
AgentOntology.definition: A Local Administrative Region in which a relatively large human population permanently resides; is designated as a city based on a particular administrative, legal, or historical status; and which delimits a local Government that typically oversees the provision of systems for sanitation, utilities, land usage, housing, and transportation.

AgentOntology.label: Civil Organization
AgentOntology.definition: An Organization that is not commercial or military and is the bearer of a Civilian Role.

AgentOntology.label: Civilian Role
AgentOntology.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent or Group of Agents by virtue of that Agent or Group of Agents not being part of either an Armed Force or police force.

AgentOntology.label: Commercial Organization
AgentOntology.definition: An Organization that is the bearer of a Commercial Role and whose primary objective is to make a profit from the provision of goods or services.

AgentOntology.label: Commercial Role
AgentOntology.definition: A Role that inheres in an Organization by virtue of its establishment as a for-profit business.

AgentOntology.label: Constituent State
AgentOntology.definition: A First-Order Administrative Region that is part of a Country and delimits a centralized regional Government that holds constitutionally-defined administrative jurisdiction over the defined geographic territory that bounds the State.

AgentOntology.label: Contractor Role
AgentOntology.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent or Group of Agents by virtue of that Agent or Group of Agents entering into a Contract to provide materials or labor to perform a service or complete a task.

AgentOntology.label: County
AgentOntology.definition: A Government Domain that is part of either a First-Order or Second-Order Administrative Region.

AgentOntology.label: Crew
AgentOntology.definition: A Group of Persons that bear Roles realized by the operation of the specified Vehicle.

AgentOntology.label: Delimiting Domain
AgentOntology.definition: A Geospatial Region that delimits the authority of an Organization to exercise its control within the bounded area.

AgentOntology.label: Disability
AgentOntology.definition: A Quality inhering in an Agent by virtue a physical or mental condition that limits the Agent's movements, senses, or activities.

AgentOntology.label: Disease
AgentOntology.definition: A Disposition to undergo pathological processes that exists in an organism because of one or more disorders in that organism.

AgentOntology.label: Division of Delimiting Domain
AgentOntology.definition: A Geospatial Region that is a fiat division of a Delimiting Domain and not a Delimiting Domain.

AgentOntology.label: Domain of a Country
AgentOntology.definition: A Government Domain that is associated with certain distinct political, ethnic, or cultural characteristics, and which delimits a Government that has legitimate authority over a Populace.

AgentOntology.label: Educational Organization
AgentOntology.definition: An Organization whose primary purpose is to provide training or otherwise facilitate learning or the acquisition of knowledge, Skills, values, beliefs, or habits.

AgentOntology.label: Enemy Person
AgentOntology.definition: A Person who is the bearer of some Enemy Role.

AgentOntology.label: Enemy Role
AgentOntology.definition: An Allegiance Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of that Agent having committed offensive Acts or exhibited intent to perform such Acts towards a particular Agent or Group of Agents or has been declared as hostile by some appropriate authority.

AgentOntology.label: Ethnic Group
AgentOntology.definition: A Group of Persons who identify with one another based on one or more shared inherited characteristics such as language, ancestry, nationality, culture, customs, religion, or social experiences.

AgentOntology.label: Ethnicity
AgentOntology.definition: A Quality that inheres in its bearers by virtue of a common heritage, often consisting of a common language, a common culture (often including a shared religion) and an ideology that stresses common ancestry or endogamy.

AgentOntology.label: Eye
AgentOntology.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of an organ that canonically affords the Agent it is part of with the ability to receive visual stimuli necessary for sight.

AgentOntology.label: Eye Color
AgentOntology.definition: A Quality inhering in an Eye by virtue of the color of the Eye's Iris.

AgentOntology.label: Facial Hair
AgentOntology.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of a portion of hair that grows on the face of a human (typically male) or other animal.

AgentOntology.label: Family
AgentOntology.definition: A Group of Persons related to one another by ancestry or marriage.

AgentOntology.label: Female Sex
AgentOntology.definition: A Biological Sex inhering in an individual that only produces gametes that can be fertilized by male gametes.

AgentOntology.label: Financial Value
AgentOntology.definition: A quality that inheres in an independent continuant to the degree that that independent continuant can serve as a medium of exchange in an economic system at a particular time.

AgentOntology.label: Financial Value of Property
AgentOntology.definition: Financial Value that inheres in an material entity that is the object of an Act of Ownership.

AgentOntology.label: First-Order Administrative Region
AgentOntology.definition: A Government Domain that is a primary administrative division of a Country.

AgentOntology.label: Fourth-Order Administrative Region
AgentOntology.definition: A Government Domain that is a subdivision of a Third-Order Administrative Region.

AgentOntology.label: Geopolitical Organization
AgentOntology.definition: An Organization that bears a Geopolitical Power Role.

AgentOntology.label: Geopolitical Power Role
AgentOntology.definition: A Role had by an Organization, that is perceived by an International Community as capable of performing influential acts in that community, and which would be realized in performing such acts.

AgentOntology.label: Geospatial Location
AgentOntology.definition: A Geospatial Region that is the location of an Independent Continuant (that is not a Spatial Region) or that environs some Process.

AgentOntology.label: Geospatial Region
AgentOntology.definition: A Site that is at or near the surface of the Earth.

AgentOntology.label: Government
AgentOntology.definition: An Organization that is the highest legitimate authority delimited by some Delimiting Domain and that exercises executive, legislative, or judicial authority in that Domain.

AgentOntology.label: Government Domain
AgentOntology.definition: A Delimiting Domain that delimits the authority of a Government to exercise its control within the bounded area.

AgentOntology.label: Government Domain Border
AgentOntology.definition: A One-Dimensional Geospatial Boundary of some Government Domain.

AgentOntology.label: Government Organization
AgentOntology.definition: An Organization that is part of a Government and is responsible for the oversight or administration of specific governmental functions.

AgentOntology.label: Government of a Country
AgentOntology.definition: A Government that has legitimate authority within and is delimited by a Domain of a Country.

AgentOntology.label: Group of Agents
AgentOntology.definition: An Object Aggregate that has only Agents as member parts.

AgentOntology.label: Group of Organizations
AgentOntology.definition: A Group of Agents that has only Organizations as member parts.

AgentOntology.label: Group of Persons
AgentOntology.definition: A Group of Agents that has only Persons as member parts.

AgentOntology.label: Hair Color
AgentOntology.definition: A Quality inhering in a portion of Hair by virtue of its color.

AgentOntology.label: Ideology
AgentOntology.definition: An Information Content Entity that consists of a collection of claims about how some part of the world is or should be and which is accepted as true by an Agent or Group of Agents such that it forms the basis of their beliefs, goals, expectations, and motivations.

AgentOntology.label: Incorporated Organization
AgentOntology.definition: An Organization formed by an Act of Incorporation that consists of an association of individuals, created by law or under authority of law, having a continuous existence independent of the existences of its members and owners, and having powers and liabilities distinct from those of its members and owners.

AgentOntology.label: Information Content Entity
AgentOntology.definition: A Generically Dependent Continuant that generically depends on some Information Bearing Entity and stands in relation of aboutness to some Entity.

AgentOntology.label: International Community
AgentOntology.definition: A maximal Group of Geopolitical Organizations engaged in geopolitics with one another.

AgentOntology.label: Interpersonal Relationship Role
AgentOntology.definition: A Role that inheres in a Person in virtue of the obligations, expectations, or social norms that govern that Person's Intentional Acts within the context of a relationship with another Person.

AgentOntology.label: Iris
AgentOntology.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of the part of an Eye that is a pigmented, round, contractile membrane, suspended between the cornea and lens and perforated by the pupil, and which canonically regulates the amount of light entering the Eye.

AgentOntology.label: Language Skill
AgentOntology.definition: A Skill that is realized by an Act which is prescribed by a Language.

AgentOntology.label: Local Administrative Region
AgentOntology.definition: A Government Domain that delimits a local Government.

AgentOntology.label: Male Sex
AgentOntology.definition: A Biological Sex inhering in an individual whose sex organs contain only male gametes.

AgentOntology.label: Material Territory of a Country
AgentOntology.definition: The portions of lithosphere, hydrosphere, or atmosphere that together exactly occupy a The Domain of a Country.
parents: Material Territory of a Government Domain

AgentOntology.label: Material Territory of a Government Domain
AgentOntology.definition: The portions of lithosphere, hydrosphere, or atmosphere that together exactly occupy a Government Domain.

AgentOntology.label: Military Personnel Force
AgentOntology.definition: An Armed Force authorized to use deadly force, and weapons, to support the interests of the Government and some or all of its Citizens.

AgentOntology.label: Neutral Person
AgentOntology.definition: A Person who is the bearer of some Neutral Role.

AgentOntology.label: Neutral Role
AgentOntology.definition: An Allegiance Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of that Agent not performing or being committed to performing Acts that have as their Objective to either support or undermine the Objectives of an Agent or Group of Agents involved in some conflict.

AgentOntology.label: Nuclear Family
AgentOntology.definition: A Family composed of parents and their children.

AgentOntology.label: Objective
AgentOntology.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some projected state that some Agent intends to achieve.

AgentOntology.label: Occupation Role
AgentOntology.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent in virtue of the responsibilities that Agent is expected to fulfill within the context of some Act of Employment.

AgentOntology.label: One-Dimensional Geospatial Boundary
AgentOntology.definition: A Fiat Line that is a boundary of some Geospatial Region.

AgentOntology.label: Operational Area
AgentOntology.definition: A Geospatial Location in which an Agent conducts some activity.

AgentOntology.label: Operator Role
AgentOntology.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of that Agent's responsibilities to operate or control some Material Artifact.

AgentOntology.label: Organism
AgentOntology.definition: An Object that is an Animal or Plant.

AgentOntology.label: Organization
AgentOntology.definition: A Group of Agents which can be the bearer of roles, has members, and has a set of organization rules.

AgentOntology.label: Organization Capability
AgentOntology.definition: An Agent Capability that inheres in an Organization to the extent of that Organization's capacity to realize it in Intentional Acts of a certain type.

AgentOntology.label: Organization Member
AgentOntology.definition: A Person who is affiliated with some Organization by being a member of that Organization.

AgentOntology.label: Organization Member Role
AgentOntology.definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent in virtue of the responsibilities that Agent is expected to fulfill as a member of some Organization.

AgentOntology.label: Paramilitary Force
AgentOntology.definition: An Armed Force whose organizational structure, training, subculture, and (often) function are similar to those of a professional Military, and which is not included as part of a Government's formal Armed Forces.

AgentOntology.label: Permanent Resident
AgentOntology.definition: A person with a Permanent Resident Role.

AgentOntology.label: Permanent Resident Role
AgentOntology.definition: A role inhering in a Person by virtue of that Person being recognized as having legal resident status in a Government Domain in which that person is not a citizen but where they have the right to reside on a permanent basis.

AgentOntology.label: Person
AgentOntology.definition: An Animal that is a member of the species Homo sapiens.

AgentOntology.label: Plan
AgentOntology.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some set of intended Intentional Acts through which some Agent expects to achieve some Objective.

AgentOntology.label: Plant
AgentOntology.definition: An Organism that is multicellular, eukaryotic, autotrophic, and has cells that contain chloroplasts and walls made of cellulose.

AgentOntology.label: Political Orientation
AgentOntology.definition: An Ideology that characterizes the political thinking of an Agent or Group of Agents, usually with respect to the political environment within a particular nation.

AgentOntology.label: Populace
AgentOntology.definition: A Group of Persons forming the total population of some Government Domain.

AgentOntology.label: Portion of Geosphere
AgentOntology.definition: A fiat object part that is composed of one or more portions of the atmosphere, cryosphere, hydrosphere, or lithosphere.

AgentOntology.label: Prescriptive Information Content Entity
AgentOntology.definition: An Information Content Entity that prescribes some Entity.

AgentOntology.label: Process Prohibition
AgentOntology.definition: A Process Regulation that prohibits some Process.

AgentOntology.label: Process Regulation
AgentOntology.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes an Process as required, prohibited, or permitted, and is the output of an Process which realizes some Authority Role.

AgentOntology.label: Process Requirement
AgentOntology.definition: A Process Regulation that requires some Process.

AgentOntology.label: Province
AgentOntology.definition: A First-Order Administrative Region that is part of a Country and delimits the authority of a magistrate who holds constitutionally-defined administrative jurisdiction over the defined geographic territory that bounds the Province.

AgentOntology.label: Religion
AgentOntology.definition: An Information Content Entity that consists of a collection of claims about the meaning or origin of existence or about the existence or nature of one or more deities, an afterlife, or spiritual or sacred entities, and which is accepted as true by an Agent or Group of Agents.

AgentOntology.label: Scalp
AgentOntology.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of the skin covering the top of the head of a human or other animal.

AgentOntology.label: Scalp Hair
AgentOntology.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of a portion of hair that grows on the scalp of a human or other animal.

AgentOntology.label: Scar
AgentOntology.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of a portion of fibrous connective tissue on skin or within body tissue and which was formed due to an injury that has not healed completely.

AgentOntology.label: Second-Order Administrative Region
AgentOntology.definition: A Government Domain that is a subdivision of a First-Order Administrative Region.

AgentOntology.label: Service Provider
AgentOntology.definition: An Organization whose purpose is to provide a service to other Agents.

AgentOntology.label: Set of Eyes
AgentOntology.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of two or more Eyes that are part of a single Agent.

AgentOntology.label: Skill
AgentOntology.definition: An Agent Capability that inheres in a Person to the extent of that Person's capacity to realize it in Intentional Acts of a certain type.

AgentOntology.label: Skin Type
AgentOntology.definition: A Quality inhering in a portion of skin by virtue of its color and natural tendency to respond to ultraviolet light.

AgentOntology.label: Social Network
AgentOntology.definition: A Group of Agents that are connected in dyadic relations by similar personal or career interests, activities, backgrounds, or real-life connections.

AgentOntology.label: Tattoo
AgentOntology.definition: A Bodily Component that consists of a typically permanent mark or design on a portion of skin that is created by a process of pricking and ingraining an indelible pigment or by raising scars.

AgentOntology.label: Third-Order Administrative Region
AgentOntology.definition: A Government Domain that is a subdivision of a Second-Order Administrative Region.

AgentOntology.label: Town
AgentOntology.definition: A Local Administrative Region in which a human population permanently resides that is typically larger than the population of a Village but smaller than that of a City; is designated as a town based on a particular administrative, legal, or historical status; and which delimits a local Government that typically exercises less power than that of a City Government.

AgentOntology.label: Village
AgentOntology.definition: A Local Administrative Region in which a human population permanently resides that is typically larger than the population of a hamlet but smaller than that of a Town.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Abbreviated Name
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Designative Name that is a shortened form of a Proper Name.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Academic Degree
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Certificate issued by an Educational Organization to a Person to indicate that the Person has satisfactorily completed a course of study, or as an honorary recognition of the Person's achievement.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Acronym
InformationEntityOntology.definition: An Abbreviated Name that combines the initial letters of a Designative Name and which is pronounced as a word.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Algorithm
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some Process and contains a finite sequence of unambiguous instructions in order to achieve some Objective.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Arbitrary Identifier
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Non-Name Identifier that consists of a string of characters that does not follow an encoding system.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Artifact Version Ordinality
InformationEntityOntology.definition: An Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity that is about the form of a Material Artifact which differs in some respects from previous or future forms of that Material Artifact.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Artificial Language
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Language that is developed through conscious planning and premeditation, rather than one that was developed through use and repetition.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Barcode
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Media Content Entity that represents one or more geometric shapes that have, as part, some Prescriptive Information Content Entity.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Book
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Document Content Entity that canonically appears as ink on paper or parchment, or other materials fastened together to hinge at one side.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Calendar Date Identifier
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Date Identifier that designates some Day by using a combination of Day, Week, Month, or Year Identifiers formatted according to an implementation of a Calendar System.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Calendar System
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Temporal Reference System that is designed to organize and identify dates.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Cartesian Coordinate System
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Spatial Reference System that identifies each point in a spatial region of n-dimensions using an ordered n-tuple of numerical coordinates that are the signed (i.e. positive or negative) distances measured in the same unit of length from the zero point where the fixed perpendicular Coordinate System Axes meet.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Certificate
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Media Content Entity that attests to certain demonstrated characteristics of an Object, Person, or Organization.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Chart
InformationEntityOntology.definition: An Image that is prescribed by some canonical visual format.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Civil Time Reference System
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Temporal Reference System that is a statutory time scale as designated by civilian authorities to determine local time(s).

InformationEntityOntology.label: Clock Time System
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Temporal Reference System that is a convention for keeping and displaying the Time of Day.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Code Identifier
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Non-Name Identifier that consists of a string of characters that was created and assigned according to an encoding system such that metadata can be derived from the identifier.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Code List
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A List whose parts are Code Identifiers.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Count Measurement Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the number of members of some aggregate.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Data Range Interval Estimate Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of a set of values and is equal to the absolute difference between the largest value and the smallest value in the set.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Database
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Media Content Entity that is designed to be rapidly searchable and retrievable.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Date Identifier
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Temporal Interval Identifier that designates some Day.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Decimal Date Identifier
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Date Identifier that designates some Day by using a number to indicate the sequential ordering of the Day since a specified Reference Time.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Decimal Time of Day Identifier
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Time of Day Identifier that designates an approximate Temporal Instant that is part of some Day and is specified using a decimal value for the portion of the Day that preceded the Temporal Instant.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Descriptive Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: An Information Content Entity that describes some Entity.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Designative Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: An Information Content Entity that consists of a set of symbols that designate some Entity.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Designative Name
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Designative Information Content Entity that consists of a string of characters that designates an entity within a specified cultural or social namespace and which is typically a word or phrase in a natural language that has an accepted cultural or social significance.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Deviation Measurement Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the extent to which an entity conforms to how it is expected or supposed to be.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Diminutive Name
InformationEntityOntology.definition: An Abbreviated Name that is a familiar form of a Proper Name.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Distance Measurement Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of a One-Dimensional Extent inhering in some Site that is externally connected to two Independent Continuants.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Document Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Media Content Entity that consists of a series of paragraphs of text or diagrams that are intended to be carried by physical pieces of paper or an electronic word processor file.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Document Field Content
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Media Content Entity that is a part of some document content entity, and which  prescribes the eliciation of information to be written or selected within the document content entity.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Email Address
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Designative Name created in order to identify some Email Box as the destination of an email message for the purpose of Email Messaging.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Email Message
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Message that is transmitted to the recipient's Email Box.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Estimate Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of an entity based on partial information about that entity or an appropriately similar entity.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Event Status Nominal Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Nominal Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the current state of a process.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Form Document
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Document Content Entity that has Document Field Contents as parts.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Geospatial Coordinate Reference System
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Spatial Reference System that is used to determine and identify the location of a point or object at or near the surface of the Earth.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Geospatial Region Bounding Box Identifier List
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Measurement Unit of Geocoordinate that is comprised of 4 pairs of coordinates, one for each of the 4 defining points (North, West, South, East) of a Geospatial Region Bounding Box.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Greenwich Mean Time Zone Identifier
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Time Zone Identifier that designates a spatial region where the local time is calculated according to the specified offset from Greenwich Mean Time.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Image
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Media Content Entity represents some entity owing to a visual isomorphism between the carrying artifact and the entity.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Information Bearing Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: An Object upon which an Information Content Entity generically depends.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Generically Dependent Continuant that generically depends on some Information Bearing Entity and stands in relation of aboutness to some Entity.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Information Line
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Media Content entity consisting of a single line or row in some Document Content entity of which it is a part.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Information Quality Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Quality that concretizes some Information Content Entity.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Initialism
InformationEntityOntology.definition: An Abbreviated Name that consists of the initial letters of some words (or syllables) in a Designative Name, and in which each letter is pronounced separately.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Interval Estimate Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: An Estimate Information Content Entity that consists of an interval of possible (or probable) values for the measured entity.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Interval Measurement Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that places a Quality of an Entity onto some interval scale having no true zero value.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Journal Article
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Document Content Entity that is part of a Journal Issue.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Julian Date Fraction
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Decimal Time of Day Identifier that designates an approximate Temporal Instant that is part of some Julian Day.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Julian Date Identifier
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Decimal Time of Day Identifier that designates a Julian Date and is composed of both a Julian Day Number and a Julian Date Fraction.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Julian Day
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Calendar Day in the Julian Calendar.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Julian Day Number
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Decimal Date Identifier that designates some Julian Day by using a number to indicate the sequential ordering of the Day since the Julian Date epoch.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Language
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes a canonical format for communication.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Legal Name
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Proper Name that is an official name for the designated entity as determined by a Government or court of law.

InformationEntityOntology.label: List
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Media Content Entity whose parts are the subject of some Sequence Position Ordinality.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Lot Number
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Code Identifier that designates a particular quantity or lot of material from a single manufacturer.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Lunar Calendar System
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Calendar System that is designed to organize and identify dates based on the cycles of the Moon's phases.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Maximum Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: An Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of some entity in virtue of it being the largest or having the greatest amount relative to a nominally described set of like entities.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Mean Point Estimate Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Point Estimate Information Content Entity that is a measurement of a set of values and is equal to the sum of all the values in the set divided by the total number of values in the set.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Measurement Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Descriptive Information Content Entity that describes the extent, dimensions, quantity, or quality of an Entity relative to some standard.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Measurement Unit
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Descriptive Information Content Entity that describes a definite magnitude of a physical quantity, defined and adopted by convention and/or by law, that is used as a standard for measurement of the same physical quantity.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Measurement Unit of Geocoordinate
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Measurement Unit specifying the geospatial coordinates of a location.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Media Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: An information content entity presented in a canonical media format.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Median Point Estimate Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Point Estimate Information Content Entity that is a measurement of a set of values and is equal to either the middle value or the average of the two values which separate the set into two equally populated upper and lower sets.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Message
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Media Content Entity that is relatively brief and designed to be transmitted from a sender to a recipient.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Military Time Zone Identifier
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Time Zone Identifier that designates a spatial region where the local time is calculated according to the specified offset from Zulu time, which has no offset from Coordinated Universal Time.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Minimum Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: An Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of some entity in virtue of it being the smallest or having the least amount relative to a nominally described set of like entities.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Mode Point Estimate Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Point Estimate Information Content Entity that is a measurement of a set of values and is equal to the value or values that occur most often in the set.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Natural Language
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Language that is developed and evolves through use and repetition, rather than through conscious planning or premeditation.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Nickname
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Designative Name that is a familiar or humorous substitute for an entity's Proper Name.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Nominal Measurement Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that consists of a symbol that classifies Entities according to some shared, possibly arbitrary, characteristic.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Non-Name Identifier
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Designative Information Content Entity that consists of a string of characters that designates an entity within a specified namespace or context, is not a Designative Name, may be automatically or randomly generated, and typically has no preexisting cultural or social significance.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Notification Message
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Message that describes a scenario that has been determined to merit attention by the recipient.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Ordinal Date Identifier
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Decimal Date Identifier that designates some Day by using a number to indicate the sequential ordering of the Day since the beginning of the Year.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that consists of a symbol that places an Entity into some rank order.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Part Number
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Code Identifier that designates a type of part whose instances are designed to be part of some Material Artifact.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Performance Specification
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some aspect of the behavior of a participant in a Process given one or more operating conditions.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Point Estimate Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: An Estimate Information Content Entity that consists of a single value for the measured entity.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Predictive Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Descriptive Information Content Entity that describes an uncertain future event.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Prescriptive Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: An Information Content Entity that prescribes some Entity.
