InformationEntityOntology.label: Priority Measurement Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: An Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the relative importance of an entity.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Priority Scale
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Reference System that is designed to be used to rank or identify the importance of entities of the specified type.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Probability Measurement Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the likelihood that a Process or Process Aggregate occurs.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Proper Name
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Designative Name that is an official name for a particular entity.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Proportional Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of a portion of a whole (described by the numerator) compared against that whole (described by the denominator) where the whole is a nominally described set of like entities.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Ratio Measurement Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that consists of a symbol that places a Quality of an Entity onto an interval scale having a true zero value.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Reference System
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Descriptive Information Content Entity that describes a set of standards for organizing and understanding data of the specified type or domain.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Reliability Measurement Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the extent to which an entity can consistently produce an outcome.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Report
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Document Content entity that conveys an account of some event, situation, or the result of some observation or inquiry.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Representational Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: An Information Content Entity that represents some Entity.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Sequence Position Ordinality
InformationEntityOntology.definition: An Ordinal Measurement Information Content Entity that is about the position of some entity in some ordered sequence.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Sidereal Time Reference System
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Temporal Reference System that is based on Earth's rate of rotation measured relative to one or more fixed Stars (rather than the Sun).

InformationEntityOntology.label: Solar Calendar System
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Calendar System that is designed to organize and identify dates based on the cycles of an Astronomical Body's Orbit around the Sun.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Solar Time Reference System
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Temporal Reference System that is based on the position of the Sun in the sky.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Spatial Reference System
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Reference System that describes a set of standards for uniquely identifying the position of an entity or the direction of a vector within a defined spatial region by means of measurements along one or more Coordinate System Axes.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Spatial Region Identifier
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Designative Information Content Entity that designates some Spatial Region.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Spherical Coordinate System
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Spatial Reference System for three-dimensional spatial regions that identifies each point using an ordered triple of numerical coordinates that consist of the radial distance of the point of interest from a fixed origin, its polar angle measured from a fixed zenith direction, and the azimuth angle of its orthogonal projection measured from a fixed direction on a reference plane that passes through the origin and is orthogonal to the zenith.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Spreadsheet
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Document Content Entity that canonically appears as a interactive, tabular form.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Standard Time of Day Identifier
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Time of Day Identifier that designates an approximate Temporal Instant that is part of some Day and is specified using the Hours, Minutes, and Seconds of the Day that preceded the Temporal Instant.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Temporal Instant Identifier
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Temporal Region Identifier that designates some Temporal Instant.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Temporal Interval Identifier
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Temporal Region Identifier that designates some Temporal Interval.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Temporal Reference System
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Reference System that describes a set of standards for measuring time as well as understanding the context of and organizing temporal data.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Temporal Region Identifier
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Designative Information Content Entity that designates some Temporal Region.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Time Zone Identifier
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Spatial Region Identifier that designates the region associated with some uniform standard time for legal, commercial, or social purposes.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Time of Day
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Temporal Instant that is part of a Day.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Time of Day Identifier
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Temporal Instant Identifier that designates some Time of Day.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Transcript
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Document Content Entity that was originally recorded in a different medium.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Universal Time Reference System
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Solar Time Reference System that is based on the average speed of the Earth's rotation and which uses the prime meridian at 0° longitude as a reference point.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Veracity Measurement Information Content Entity
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Measurement Information Content Entity that is a measurement of the extent to which a description conforms to the reality it describes.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Video
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Media Content Entity that contains a sequence of representations that are presented sufficiently rapidly to create the appearance of motion and continuity.

InformationEntityOntology.label: Warning Message
InformationEntityOntology.definition: A Message that describes a possible or impending threat.

QualityOntology.label: Albedo
QualityOntology.definition: A Radiation Reflectivity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of its surface to reflect incident electromagnetic radiation of a particular wavelength.

QualityOntology.label: Altitude
QualityOntology.definition: A Height that inheres in a Site that externally connects an Independent Continuant to either the surface of the Earth or the Earth's mean Sea Level.

QualityOntology.label: Amount
QualityOntology.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the total, aggregate or sum of a number of discrete items or material the entity contains as parts.

QualityOntology.label: Bent
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having one or more angles along its border.

QualityOntology.label: Black
QualityOntology.definition: A Color that lacks any hues as parts.

QualityOntology.label: Blond
QualityOntology.definition: A Color that ranges from nearly white to a light greyish yellow.

QualityOntology.label: Blue
QualityOntology.definition: A Color that is between Cyan and Violet with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 450 to 490 nanometers.

QualityOntology.label: Blunt
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer not having a sharp edge or point.

QualityOntology.label: Body Shape
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a Person's body by virtue of the body's general outline or figure.

QualityOntology.label: Branched
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having subdivisions or offshoots.

QualityOntology.label: Brown
QualityOntology.definition: A Color that consists of dark orange and red, and of very low intensity.

QualityOntology.label: Circumference
QualityOntology.definition: A Perimeter that inheres in a circle or ellipse.

QualityOntology.label: Closure
QualityOntology.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the degree to which that bearer affords passage or sightline through it via an opening, aperture, orifice, or vent.

QualityOntology.label: Coiled
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer being wound in concentric rings or spirals.

QualityOntology.label: Color
QualityOntology.definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's Color Hue, Color Saturation and Color Brightness.

QualityOntology.label: Color Brightness
QualityOntology.definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to reflect or radiate light.

QualityOntology.label: Color Hue
QualityOntology.definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to reflect a dominant wavelength of the visible light spectrum, which is typically divided up into 6 to 8 ranges.

QualityOntology.label: Color Saturation
QualityOntology.definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to reflect high intensity light distributed across fewer wavelengths, typically considered on a continuum of purity.

QualityOntology.label: Concave Shape
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having one or more cavities, such that at least one line connecting a pair of points on the surface of the bearer will lie outside.

QualityOntology.label: Cone Shape
QualityOntology.definition: A Three Dimensional Shape that inheres in a bearer in virtue of it having a Round base that tapers smoothly to an apex.

QualityOntology.label: Convex Shape
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer not having a cavity, such that no line connecting a pair of points on the surface of the bearer will lie outside.

QualityOntology.label: Cube Shape
QualityOntology.definition: A Cuboidal shape inhering in a bearer in virtue of it having six Square faces.

QualityOntology.label: Cuboidal
QualityOntology.definition: A Three Dimensional Shape that inheres in a bearer in virtue of it having six Rectangular faces.

QualityOntology.label: Curved
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having borders which are smoothly rounded.

QualityOntology.label: Cyan
QualityOntology.definition: A Color that is between Green and Blue with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 490 and 520 nanometers.

QualityOntology.label: Cylindrical
QualityOntology.definition: A Three Dimensional Shape inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having an elongated shape with round bases.

QualityOntology.label: Depth
QualityOntology.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in a downward, backward, or inward direction.

QualityOntology.label: Diameter
QualityOntology.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a circle in virtue of the extent of a straight line that passes through the center of the circle and starts and ends on the circle's boundary.

QualityOntology.label: Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation
QualityOntology.definition: A Disposition that inheres in a bearer in virtue of how that bearer interacts with electromagnetic radiation.

QualityOntology.label: Disrupting Disposition
QualityOntology.definition: A disposition the realization of which would disrupt a process some entity has an interest in.

QualityOntology.label: Drooping
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a border that hangs downwards.

QualityOntology.label: Fatigability
QualityOntology.definition: A Realizable Entity that is realized when its bearer loses strength and tires quickly.

QualityOntology.label: Flat
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a horizontal border without a significant deviation.

QualityOntology.label: Fluorescence
QualityOntology.definition: A Luminescent Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to emit visible light while absorbing shorter wavelength radiation, but not after.

QualityOntology.label: Folded
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of one part of the bearer being layered over another connected part.

QualityOntology.label: Gold Color
QualityOntology.definition: A Color that resembles a yellow-orange Hue with the added feature of having a metallic shine.

QualityOntology.label: Green
QualityOntology.definition: A Color that is between Yellow and Cyan with a wavelength in the visible spectrum, typically between 520 to 560 nanometers.

QualityOntology.label: Grey
QualityOntology.definition: A Color between white and black colors.

QualityOntology.label: Hardness
QualityOntology.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the degree to which it can be turned, bowed, or twisted without breaking.

QualityOntology.label: Hazel
QualityOntology.definition: A Color that is a combination of Brown and Green, typically associated with eye color.

QualityOntology.label: Height
QualityOntology.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in a vertical direction.

QualityOntology.label: Length
QualityOntology.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's greatest extent in one direction.

QualityOntology.label: Luminescent Property
QualityOntology.definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to emit visible light, but which isn't the result of the bearer being heated.

QualityOntology.label: Magenta
QualityOntology.definition: A Color consisting of red and blue hues.

QualityOntology.label: Magnetism
QualityOntology.definition: A Disposition that is realized when its bearer exerts a magnetic force on another entity.

QualityOntology.label: Maroon
QualityOntology.definition: A Color consisting of purple and brown hue.

QualityOntology.label: Mass
QualityOntology.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the amount of matter in that bearer.

QualityOntology.label: Mass Density
QualityOntology.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's mass per unit volume.

QualityOntology.label: Oblong
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having an long thin shape with approximately parallel sides.

QualityOntology.label: One Dimensional Extent
QualityOntology.definition: A Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in one dimension.

QualityOntology.label: Opacity
QualityOntology.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to transmit electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer instead of reflecting, scattering, or absorbing electromangentic radiation of that frequency.
parents: Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation

QualityOntology.label: Opaque
QualityOntology.definition: An Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's incapacity to transmit electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer such that the bearer reflects, scatters, or absorbs all electromagnetic radiation of that frequency.

QualityOntology.label: Optical Property
QualityOntology.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that is realized when its bearer interacts with electromagnetic waves within the visible light spectrum.
parents: Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation

QualityOntology.label: Orange
QualityOntology.definition: A Color that is between Red and Yellow with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 590 to 635 nanometers.

QualityOntology.label: Perimeter
QualityOntology.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the extent of a boundary which encloses the bearer.

QualityOntology.label: Phase Angle
QualityOntology.definition: A Relational Quality that is the angle between the light incident onto an observed Object and the light reflected from the Object.

QualityOntology.label: Phosphorescence
QualityOntology.definition: A Luminescent Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to emit visible light after absorbing shorter wavelength radiation, and to continue emitting after the absorbing process has ceased.

QualityOntology.label: Pitch Orientation
QualityOntology.definition: A Spatial Orientation of an Object relative to its Pitch Axis.

QualityOntology.label: Pointing Orientation
QualityOntology.definition: A Spatial Orientation of a Material Entity in which one or more of its designated components are oriented toward a specified direction.

QualityOntology.label: Protruding
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a part of an object in virtue of the part extending out above or beyond the surface of the object.

QualityOntology.label: Purple
QualityOntology.definition: A Color that is aproximately midway between Red and Blue.

QualityOntology.label: Pyramidal
QualityOntology.definition: A Three Dimensional Shape that inheres in a bearer in virtue of it having a polygonal base with vertices that all connect to the same apex to form triangular faces.

QualityOntology.label: Radiation Absorptivity
QualityOntology.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to absorb electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency.
parents: Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation

QualityOntology.label: Radiation Emissivity
QualityOntology.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to emit electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency.
parents: Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation

QualityOntology.label: Radiation Reflectivity
QualityOntology.definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to scatter or reflect electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency.
parents: Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation

QualityOntology.label: Radioactive
QualityOntology.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer exhibiting or being caused by radioactivity.

QualityOntology.label: Radiolucent
QualityOntology.definition: A Radiopacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to permit most X-rays to pass through it.

QualityOntology.label: Radiopacity
QualityOntology.definition: An Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to allow or prevent X-rays to pass through it.

QualityOntology.label: Radiopaque
QualityOntology.definition: A Radiopacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to prevent most X-rays from passing through it.

QualityOntology.label: Rectangular
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of having four sides and four 90 degree angles.

QualityOntology.label: Red
QualityOntology.definition: A Color that is above Orange with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 635 to 700 nanometers.

QualityOntology.label: Refractivity
QualityOntology.definition: A Radiation Reflectivity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to change the direction of a propagating wave when passing through it.

QualityOntology.label: Roll Orientation
QualityOntology.definition: A Spatial Orientation of an Object relative to its Roll Axis.

QualityOntology.label: Rosy
QualityOntology.definition: A Color consisting of red hue and yellow hue and high brightness.

QualityOntology.label: Round
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of every point along its circumference being equidistant from the center.

QualityOntology.label: Semicircular
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having the shape of half a circle.

QualityOntology.label: Serrated
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having multiple sharp points along a edge.

QualityOntology.label: Shape Quality
QualityOntology.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the ratios between dimensions of external features of that bearer.

QualityOntology.label: Sharp
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a fine point or thin edge.

QualityOntology.label: Silver Color
QualityOntology.definition: A Color that resembles Grey with the added feature of having a metallic shine.

QualityOntology.label: Size Quality
QualityOntology.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in one or more dimensions.

QualityOntology.label: Sloped
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a horizontal border which is not level.

QualityOntology.label: Spatial Orientation
QualityOntology.definition: A Relational Quality that is the angle of Rotation of an Object relative to one or more Plane of Reference or Axis of Rotation.

QualityOntology.label: Spherical
QualityOntology.definition: A Three Dimensional Shape inhering in a bearer in virtue of all of its cross sections being round.

QualityOntology.label: Split
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a linear opening, or having been divided into parts.

QualityOntology.label: Square
QualityOntology.definition: A Rectangular shape which has four equal length sides and four 90 degree angles.

QualityOntology.label: Straight
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer not having curves, bends, or angles along its borders.

QualityOntology.label: Strength
QualityOntology.definition: A Realizable Entity that is realized when its bearer exerts or resists some power, influence, or force.

QualityOntology.label: Surface Tension
QualityOntology.definition: A Disposition that inheres in a liquid and is realized when the cohesive forces of the molecules in the bearer at the surface are greater than the adhesive forces of the molecules in the surrounding air.

QualityOntology.label: Temperature
QualityOntology.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its thermal energy.

QualityOntology.label: Texture
QualityOntology.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the size, shape, and distribution of features on its surface, typically on a continuum from smooth to rough.

QualityOntology.label: Thickness
QualityOntology.definition: A Depth that inheres in a bearer in virtue of it extending inward through an object.

QualityOntology.label: Thin
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a width or depth which is significantly smaller in proportion to its length or height.

QualityOntology.label: Three Dimensional Extent
QualityOntology.definition: A Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in three dimensions.

QualityOntology.label: Three Dimensional Shape
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality that inheres only in a three dimensional entity.

QualityOntology.label: Translucent
QualityOntology.definition: An Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to transmit some but not all electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer such that the bearer reflects, scatters, or absorbs some but not all electromagnetic radiation of that frequency.

QualityOntology.label: Transparent
QualityOntology.definition: An Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to transmit all or nearly all electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer such that the bearer reflects, scatters, or absorbs little or no electromagnetic radiation of that frequency.

QualityOntology.label: Triangular
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of it having exactly three angles and exactly three sides.

QualityOntology.label: Two Dimensional Extent
QualityOntology.definition: A Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in two dimensions.

QualityOntology.label: Vermilion
QualityOntology.definition: A Color consisting of red and orange hue with a slight amount of gray.

QualityOntology.label: Violet
QualityOntology.definition: A Color that is lower than Blue with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 400 and 450 nanometers.

QualityOntology.label: Vulnerability
QualityOntology.definition: A Disrupting Disposition the realization of which would disrupt a process that the bearer of the Disrupting Disposition has an interest in.

QualityOntology.label: Wavy
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of it having a sinuous or rippled border.

QualityOntology.label: Weight
QualityOntology.definition: A Quality that inheres in some material entity with a mass in virtue of its location in some gravitational field.

QualityOntology.label: Wetness
QualityOntology.definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the degree to which the bearer is covered by a liquid, typically on a continuum of dry to wet.

QualityOntology.label: White
QualityOntology.definition: A Color of maximum brightness, the color of objects that reflect nearly all wavelengths of the visible light spectrum, thus considered achromatic.

QualityOntology.label: Wide
QualityOntology.definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a width or depth which is significantly larger in proportion to its length or height.

QualityOntology.label: Width
QualityOntology.definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in a horizontal direction.

QualityOntology.label: Yaw Orientation
QualityOntology.definition: A Spatial Orientation of an Object relative to its Yaw Axis.

QualityOntology.label: Yellow
QualityOntology.definition: A Color that is between Orange and Green with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 560 to 590 nanometers.

EventOntology.label: Acceleration
EventOntology.definition: A Process Profile that is the rate of change of the Velocity of an object.

EventOntology.label: Act
EventOntology.definition: A Process in which at least one Agent plays a causative role.

EventOntology.label: Act of Advising
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Directive Communication performed by providing advice or counsel to another agent.

EventOntology.label: Act of Apologizing
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Expressive Communication performed by acknowledging and expressing regret for a fault, shortcoming, or failure.

EventOntology.label: Act of Appraisal
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Measuring that involves evaluating, assessing, estimating, or judging the nature, value, importance, condition, or quality of something or someone.

EventOntology.label: Act of Arrival
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Location Change that consists of the participating entity reaching its destination such that the larger Act of Location Change is completed.

EventOntology.label: Act of Artifact Assembly
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Material Artifact Processing wherein a new Material Artifact are created by fitting component parts together.

EventOntology.label: Act of Artifact Employment
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act of using a Material Artifact.

EventOntology.label: Act of Artifact Modification
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Material Artifact Processing in which an existing Material Artifact is acted upon in a manner that changes, adds, or removes one or more of its Qualities, Dispositions, or Functions.

EventOntology.label: Act of Assassination
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Murder of a prominent person.

EventOntology.label: Act of Assignment
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Declarative Communication in which rights held by one party (the assignor) are transferred to another party (the assignee) with regard to a particular entity as specified by the details of the assignment, which is often prescribed by a contract.

EventOntology.label: Act of Association
EventOntology.definition: A Social Act wherein an Agent unites with some other Agent in a Planned Act, enterprise or business.

EventOntology.label: Act of Buying
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Purchasing wherein a Financial Instrument is used by an Agent (the Buyer) to acquire ownership of a good from another Agent (the Seller).

EventOntology.label: Act of Cargo Transportation
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Location Change wherein some Payload is moved from one location to another.

EventOntology.label: Act of Censuring
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Expressive Communication performed by expressing strong disapproval or criticism.

EventOntology.label: Act of Ceremony
EventOntology.definition: A Social Act of ritual significance, performed on a special occasion.

EventOntology.label: Act of Change of Residence
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Location Change involving one or more Persons moving from one place of residence to another.

EventOntology.label: Act of Collision
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Location Change involving the movement of one object such that it collides with another object.

EventOntology.label: Act of Commanding
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Directive Communication through which an Agent exercises authoritative control or power over another Agent's actions.

EventOntology.label: Act of Commissive Communication
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Communication in which an Agent commits themselves to doing, or refraining from doing, some future action.

EventOntology.label: Act of Communication
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act in which the objective is to create a concretization of some Information Content Entity in one or more recipients.

EventOntology.label: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Communication in which technology is used to create a new copy of the Information Content Entity in the recipient.

EventOntology.label: Act of Communication by Movement of Information Bearing Artifact
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Communication in which some Material Artifact is used to transfer an Information Bearing Entity from sender(s) to receiver(s).

EventOntology.label: Act of Condoling
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Expressive Communication performed by expressing sympathy or sorrow.

EventOntology.label: Act of Conducting Mass Media Interview
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Mass Media Communication involving a conversation between a reporter and a person of public interest, used as a basis of a broadcast or publication.

EventOntology.label: Act of Confessing
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Representative Communication in which a person makes an admission of misdeeds or faults.

EventOntology.label: Act of Congratulating
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Expressive Communication performed by expressing vicarious pleasure to a person on the occasion of their success or good fortune.

EventOntology.label: Act of Construction
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Material Artifact Processing wherein Material Artifacts are built on site as prescribed by some contract.

EventOntology.label: Act of Consumption
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act in which a resource is ingested or used up.

EventOntology.label: Act of Contract Formation
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Promising having a lawful object entered into voluntarily by two or more agents with legal capacity, each of whom intends to create one or more legal obligations between them.

EventOntology.label: Act of Data Transformation
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Information Processing in which an algorithm is executed to act upon one or more input Information Content Entities into one or more output Information Content Entities.

EventOntology.label: Act of Deceptive Communication
EventOntology.definition: Ac Act of Communication intended to mislead the audience by distortion or falsification of evidence and induce a reaction that is prejudicial to the interests of the audience.

EventOntology.label: Act of Declarative Communication
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Communication that changes the reality in accord with the content of the declaration.

EventOntology.label: Act of Decoy Use
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Decoy.

EventOntology.label: Act of Denying
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Representative Communication performed by either asserting that something is not true or real or refusing to satisfy a request or desire.

EventOntology.label: Act of Departure
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Location Change that consists of the participating entity leaving its starting location such that the larger Act of Location Change is initiated.

EventOntology.label: Act of Directive Communication
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Communication that is intended to cause the hearer to take a particular action.

EventOntology.label: Act of Donating
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is tranfered by an Agent (the Donor) to another Agent (the Recipient) without return consideration.

EventOntology.label: Act of Educational Training Acquisition
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Training Acquisition performed by an Agent by acquiring knowledge of a curriculum from an Agent or communication medium that realizes a capacity derived from its affiliation with some Educational Organization.

EventOntology.label: Act of Educational Training Instruction
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Training Instruction performed by an Agent who realizes a capacity derived from the Agent's affiliation with some Educational Organization by imparting knowledge of a curriculum to an Agent either directly or indirectly through some communication medium.

EventOntology.label: Act of Employment
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Association wherein an Agent assigns a set of activities to some Person to be performed in exchange for financial compensation.

EventOntology.label: Act of Employment by an Organization
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Employment wherein an Organization assigns a set of activities to some Person to be performed in exchange for financial compensation.

EventOntology.label: Act of Encounter
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Association wherein two or more Persons meet in a casual or unplanned manner.

EventOntology.label: Act of Entertainment
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act consisting of any activity which provides a diversion or permits people to amuse themselves.

EventOntology.label: Act of Espionage
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Intelligence Gathering involving the obtaining of information that is considered secret or confidential without the permission of the holder of the information.

EventOntology.label: Act of Estimation
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Measuring that involves the comparison of a measurement of a similar Entity or of a portion of the Entity being estimated to produce an approximated measurement of the target Entity.

EventOntology.label: Act of Expressive Communication
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Communication in which an Agent expresses their attitudes or emotions towards some entity.

EventOntology.label: Act of Facility Use
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which an Agent makes use of some Facility.

EventOntology.label: Act of Financial Deposit
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is transferred by an Agent (the Depositor) to another Agent to create a liability to be repaid to the Depositor through an Act of Financial Withdrawal.

EventOntology.label: Act of Financial Instrument Use
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Financial Instrument.

EventOntology.label: Act of Financial Withdrawal
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is transferred by an Agent to another Agent (the Depositor) from an account created by an earlier Act of Financial Deposit performed by the Depositor.

EventOntology.label: Act of Funding
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use in which an Agent (the Funder) provides some Financial Instrument to another Agent (the recipient of the funds) as a resource pool that is earmarked by the Funder for a future transaction.

EventOntology.label: Act of Government
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act that is initiated or supported by some Geopolitical Entity and enforced by some Government Agent.

EventOntology.label: Act of Homicide
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Violence which causes the unlawful killing of another person.

EventOntology.label: Act of Identifying
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Representative Communication performed by asserting who or what a particular person or thing is.

EventOntology.label: Act of Information Processing
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act in which one or more input Information Content Entities are received, manipulated, transferred, or stored by an Agent.

EventOntology.label: Act of Inhabitancy
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act in which a Person lives at a Site for a period of time that may be as short as 1 day/night or as long as the Person's entire life.

EventOntology.label: Act of Intelligence Gathering
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act of producing and/or gathering information by a government or other Organization to guide decisions and actions by answering questions or obtaining advance warning of events and movements deemed to be important or otherwise relevant.

EventOntology.label: Act of Interpersonal Relationship
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Association between two or more Persons that may range from fleeting to enduring.

EventOntology.label: Act of Inviting
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Commissive Communication performed by requesting the presence or participation of the audience, and which may include offering an incentive or inducement.

EventOntology.label: Act of Issuing
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Mass Media Communication involving sending forth, distributing, or putting into circulation some Information Content Entity.

EventOntology.label: Act of Issuing Mass Media Article
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Issuing a non-fictional essay, especially one included with others in a newspaper, magazine, or journal.

EventOntology.label: Act of Issuing Mass Media Documentary
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Issuing information that provides a factual record or report.

EventOntology.label: Act of Issuing Mass Media Press Release
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Issuing an official statement to one or more members of the media for the purpose of announcing newsworthy information.

EventOntology.label: Act of Legal Instrument Use
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Legal Instrument.

EventOntology.label: Act of Loaning
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is given by an Agent (the Creditor) to another Agent (the Debtor) in order to receive Repayments from the Debtor which are of greater Financial Value.

EventOntology.label: Act of Location Change
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Motion in which the location of some Object is changed by some Agent.

EventOntology.label: Act of Maintenance
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Artifact Modification in which a Material Artifact is modified in order to preserve or restore one or more of its designed Qualities or Functions.

EventOntology.label: Act of Manufacturing
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Material Artifact Processing wherein Material Artifacts are mass produced in a Facility for the purpose of being sold or distributed to consumers.

EventOntology.label: Act of Mass Media Communication
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Communication intended to reach a large audience using a medium such as the internet, television, radio, newspaper, or magazine.

EventOntology.label: Act of Material Artifact Processing
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act of performing a series of physical operations on a material artifact in order to change or preserve the artifact.

EventOntology.label: Act of Measuring
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act that involves determining the extent, dimensions, quanity, or quality of an Entity relative to some standard.

EventOntology.label: Act of Meeting
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Association wherein two or more Persons assemble for some common purpose.

EventOntology.label: Act of Military Force
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act of employing a Military Force to achieve some desired result.

EventOntology.label: Act of Military Service
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Employment by an Organization wherein a Person serves as a member of a Military Force, whether voluntarily or by conscription.
parents: Act of Employment by an Organization

EventOntology.label: Act of Military Training Acquisition
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Training Acquisition performed by an Agent by acquiring knowledge of the tactics, techniques, and/or strategies of Military Operations from an Agent or communication medium that realizes a capacity derived from its affiliation with a Military Organization.

EventOntology.label: Act of Military Training Instruction
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Training Instruction performed by an Agent who realizes a capacity derived from the Agent's affiliation with some Military Organization by imparting knowledge of the tactics, techniques, and/or strategies of Military Operations to an Agent either directly or indirectly through some communication medium.

EventOntology.label: Act of Motion
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act by which an Agent causes the position or location of some Object to change.

EventOntology.label: Act of Murder
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Homicide with malice aforethought.

EventOntology.label: Act of Oath Taking
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Commissive Communication performed by stating or promising, usually calling upon something or someone that the oath maker considers sacred.

EventOntology.label: Act of Observation
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act of acquiring information from a source via the use of one or more senses.

EventOntology.label: Act of Official Documentation
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Declarative Communication in which an Agent records some information for official use by another Agent.

EventOntology.label: Act of Ownership
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Possession that includes an agent having certain rights and duties over the property owned.

EventOntology.label: Act of Personal Communication
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Communication that the sender intends to be received by a small audience.

EventOntology.label: Act of Pilgrimage
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Travel to a location of importance to a person's beliefs and faith.

EventOntology.label: Act of Planning
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act that involves making a Plan to achieve some specified Objective.

EventOntology.label: Act of Portion of Material Consumption
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which a Portion of Material is expended.

EventOntology.label: Act of Position Change
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Motion in which the position (i.e. the orientation, alignment, or arrangement) of some Object or of one or more of an Object's parts is changed by some Agent.

EventOntology.label: Act of Possession
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act in which an agent intentionally exercises control towards a thing.

EventOntology.label: Act of Prediction
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act that involves the generation of a Predictive Information Content entity that is intended to describe an uncertain possible future event, value, entity, or attribute of an entity.

EventOntology.label: Act of Promising
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Commissive Communication performed by declaring that the promising agent will do, or refrain from doing, the specified action.

EventOntology.label: Act of Propaganda
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Deceptive Communication Propaganda intended to influence the attitude of a mass audience toward some cause or position by presenting facts selectively (thus possibly lying by omission) or by using loaded messages to produce an emotional rather than rational response to the information presented.

EventOntology.label: Act of Publishing
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Mass Media Communication involving the preparation and public issuance of information.

EventOntology.label: Act of Publishing Mass Media Article
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Publishing a non-fictional essay, especially one included with others in a newspaper, magazine, journal, etc.

EventOntology.label: Act of Publishing Mass Media Documentary
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Publishing a factual record or report.

EventOntology.label: Act of Publishing Mass Media Press Release
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Publishing an official statement to one or more members of the media for the purpose of announcing newsworthy information.

EventOntology.label: Act of Purchasing
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is used by an Agent (the Purchaser) to acquire a good or service from another Agent (the Provider).

EventOntology.label: Act of Reconnaissance
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Intelligence Gathering used to determine an Agent's disposition and intention; the composition and capabilities of Equipment and Facilities, and the surrounding landforms and weather conditions.

EventOntology.label: Act of Refrain
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act in which some Agent avoids or stops themselves from participating in some Planned Act.

EventOntology.label: Act of Religious Group Affiliation
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Association wherein some Person belongs to some Religious Demonination or sub-Denomination.

EventOntology.label: Act of Religious Training Acquisition
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Training Acquisition performed by an Agent by acquiring knowledge of the tenets and/or practices of a religion from an Agent or communication medium that realizes a capacity derived from its affiliation with a Religious Organization.

EventOntology.label: Act of Religious Training Instruction
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Training Instruction performed by an Agent who realizes a capacity derived from the Agent's affiliation with some Religious Organization by imparting knowledge of the tenets and/or practices of a religion to an Agent either directly or indirectly through some communication medium.

EventOntology.label: Act of Religious Worship
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Ceremony wherein there occurs acts of religious devotion usually directed towards a deity.

EventOntology.label: Act of Remuneration
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Purchasing wherein a Financial Instrument is used by an Agent (the Employer) to compensate another Agent (the Employee) for the services they perform for the Employer.

EventOntology.label: Act of Renting
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Purchasing wherein a Financial Instrument is used by an Agent (the Renter) as a payment to acquire temporary possession or use of a good or property that is owned or controlled by another Agent (the Seller).

EventOntology.label: Act of Repayment
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Financial Instrument Use wherein a Financial Instrument is transferred by an Agent (the Debtor) to another Agent (the Creditor) to decrease the amount the Debtor owes to the Creditor from an earlier Act of Loaning.

EventOntology.label: Act of Reporting
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Representative Communication performed by giving a detailed account or statement.

EventOntology.label: Act of Representative Communication
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Communication that commits a speaker to the truth of the expressed content.

EventOntology.label: Act of Requesting
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Directive Communication performed by asking for something.

EventOntology.label: Act of Residing
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Inhabitancy in which a Person lives in a dwelling permanently or for an extended period of time.

EventOntology.label: Act of Social Group Membership
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Association wherein a Person belongs to some Social Group.

EventOntology.label: Act of Social Movement
EventOntology.definition: A Social Act composed of a series of performances, displays and campaigns directed at implementing, resisting or undoing a change in society.

EventOntology.label: Act of Sojourn
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Inhabitancy in which a Person lives in a dwelling temporarily, often during stages of an Act of Travel.

EventOntology.label: Act of Suicide
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Violence in which some Agent intentionally and voluntarily causes their own death.

EventOntology.label: Act of Targeting
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act wherein some Agent maintains one or more entities as the objects of potential action given some operational requirement.

EventOntology.label: Act of Terrorism
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Violence which creates fear and which is prescribed by religious, political or ideological objectives, and which deliberately target or disregard the safety of civilians and are committed by members of non-government organizations.

EventOntology.label: Act of Terrorist Training Acquisition
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Training Acquisition performed by an Agent by acquiring knowledge of the tactics, techniques, and/or strategies of the use of violence against civilians in order to attain goals that are political, religous, or ideological in nature from an Agent or communication medium that realizes a capacity derived from its affiliation with a Terrorist Organization.

EventOntology.label: Act of Terrorist Training Instruction
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Training Instruction performed by an Agent who realizes a capacity derived from the Agent's affiliation with some Terrorist Organization by imparting knowledge of the tactics, techniques, and/or strategies of the use of violence against civilians in order to attain goals that are political, religous, or ideological in nature to an Agent either directly or indirectly through some communication medium.

EventOntology.label: Act of Testifying
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Representative Communication performed by stating one's personal knowledge or belief.

EventOntology.label: Act of Thanking
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Expressive Communication performed by expressing gratitude.

EventOntology.label: Act of Tool Use
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Tool.

EventOntology.label: Act of Training
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act in which knowledge, skills or values are imparted from one or more Agents to at least one other Agent.

EventOntology.label: Act of Training Acquisition
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Training performed by an Agent by acquiring knowledge from another Agent.

EventOntology.label: Act of Training Instruction
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Training performed by an Agent by imparting knowledge to another Agent.

EventOntology.label: Act of Travel
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Location Change wherein one or more Persons move between relatively distant geographical locations for any purpose and any duration, with or without any means of transport.

EventOntology.label: Act of Vehicle Use
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Vehicle.

EventOntology.label: Act of Violence
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act of causing harm to oneself or to another through the use of physical or verbal force.

EventOntology.label: Act of Vocational Training Acquisition
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Training Acquisition performed by an Agent by acquiring skills required for a specific occupation in industry, agriculture or trade from an Agent or communication medium that realizes a capacity derived from its affiliation with a Vocational School, Technical School, Trade Organization, or Industry Educational Program Provider.

EventOntology.label: Act of Vocational Training Instruction
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Training Instruction performed by an Agent who realizes a capacity derived from the Agent's affiliation with a Vocational School, Technical School, Trade Organization, or Industry Educational Program Provider by imparting skills required for a specific occupation in industry, agriculture or trade to an Agent either directly or indirectly through some communication medium.

EventOntology.label: Act of Volunteering
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Commissive Communication performed by voluntarily undertaking or expressing a willingness to undertake a service.

EventOntology.label: Act of Walking
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Travel that proceeds by foot.

EventOntology.label: Act of Warning
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Directive Communication performed by indicating a possible or impending danger, problem, or other unpleasant situation.

EventOntology.label: Act of Weapon Use
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Artifact Employment in which some Agent uses some Weapon.

EventOntology.label: Active Stasis
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Artifact Operationality that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact is realizing one or more of its designed Artifact Functions (especially one of its primary functions).

EventOntology.label: Amplitude
EventOntology.definition: A Process Profile of an Oscillation Process that is the absolute value of the maximum displacement from a zero, equilibrium, or mean value during one cycle of the Oscillation Process.

EventOntology.label: Angular Momentum
EventOntology.definition: A Momentum that is the product of an object's moment of inertia and its Angular Velocity.

EventOntology.label: Angular Velocity
EventOntology.definition: A Velocity that is characterized by both the angular Speed of an object and the Axis about which the object is Rotating.

EventOntology.label: Bass Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 60 and 250 Hz.

EventOntology.label: Beginning of Life Stasis
EventOntology.definition: A Operational Stasis that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact is first put into operational use such that its designed set of Artifact Functions is capable of operating at or near their designed peak performance levels.

EventOntology.label: Behavior
EventOntology.definition: An Act in which an Independent Continuant participates as an Agent in response to external or internal stimuli and following some pattern which is dependent upon some combination of that Independent Continuant's internal state and external conditions.

EventOntology.label: Biographical Life
EventOntology.definition: An Act composed of the Life Events that occur during the course of existence of an Agent (i.e. Person or Organization).

EventOntology.label: Birth
EventOntology.definition: A Process of bringing forth offspring.

EventOntology.label: Brilliance Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 6 and 20 kHz.

EventOntology.label: Cause
EventOntology.definition: A Process that is the cause of or one of the causes of some other Process.

EventOntology.label: Change
EventOntology.definition: A Process in which some independent continuant endures and 1) one or more of the dependent entities it bears increase or decrease in intensity, 2) the entity begins to bear some dependent entity or 3) the entity ceases to bear some dependent entity.

EventOntology.label: Clockwise Rotational Motion
EventOntology.definition: A Rotational Motion in which the direction of rotation is toward the right as seen relative to the designated side of the plane of rotation.

EventOntology.label: Combustion
EventOntology.definition: A Natural Process in which a Portion of Fuel or other Material Entity is burned.

EventOntology.label: Counter-Clockwise Rotational Motion
EventOntology.definition: A Rotational Motion in which the direction of rotation is toward the left as seen relative to the designated side of the plane of rotation.

EventOntology.label: Criminal Act
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act committed in violation of rules or laws for which some governing authority (via mechanisms such as legal systems) can prescribe a conviction.

EventOntology.label: Curvilinear Motion
EventOntology.definition: A Translational Motion process in which an Object moves along a curved path.

EventOntology.label: Damaged Stasis
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant bears a Quality or Realizable Entity that has suffered impairment (i.e., a decrease or loss) due to a previous action or event such that the Independent Continuant is now of lesser value, usefulness, or functionality.

EventOntology.label: Deactivated Stasis
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Artifact Operationality that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact is not realizing any of its designed Artifact Functions (or at least not realizing any of its primary functions).

EventOntology.label: Death
EventOntology.definition: A Natural Process in which all biological functions that sustain a living organism cease.

EventOntology.label: Decrease of Dependent Continuant
EventOntology.definition: A Change in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease in the level of some Dependent Continuant that it bears.

EventOntology.label: Decrease of Disposition
EventOntology.definition: A Decrease of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease of some Disposition it bears.

EventOntology.label: Decrease of Function
EventOntology.definition: A Decrease of Disposition in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease of some Function that it bears.

EventOntology.label: Decrease of Generically Dependent Continuant
EventOntology.definition: A Decrease of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease in the level of a Generically Dependent Continuant that it bears.

EventOntology.label: Decrease of Quality
EventOntology.definition: A Decrease of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease of some Quality that it bears.

EventOntology.label: Decrease of Realizable Entity
EventOntology.definition: A Decrease of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease of some Realizable Entity that it bears.

EventOntology.label: Decrease of Role
EventOntology.definition: A Decrease of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease of some Role that it bears.

EventOntology.label: Decrease of Specifically Dependent Continuant
EventOntology.definition: A Decrease of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has a decrease in some Specifically Dependent Continuant that it bears.

EventOntology.label: Defunct Stasis
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Artifact Operationality that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact no longer maintains its designed set of Artifact Functions (or at least no longer maintains its primary functions).

EventOntology.label: Delta-v
EventOntology.definition: A Process Profile that is the total change in Velocity of an object's Motion.

EventOntology.label: Effect
EventOntology.definition: A Process that follows and is caused by some previous Process.

EventOntology.label: Effect of Location Change
EventOntology.definition: An Effect caused by some Act of Location Change and which results in an Object being located in a different place.

EventOntology.label: Election
EventOntology.definition: A Social Act by which a population chooses an individual to hold public office.

EventOntology.label: Electromagnetic Pulse
EventOntology.definition: An Electromagnetic Wave Process that consists of a short high-energy burst of electromagnetic energy.

EventOntology.label: Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Frequency that is characterized by the rate of Oscillations per second of an Electromagnetic Wave.

EventOntology.label: Electromagnetic Wave Process
EventOntology.definition: A Wave Process that is produced by charged particles, involves the periodic Oscillation of electric and magnetic fields at right angles to each other and the direction of wave propogation such that it has a Transverse Wave Profile, and which transfers electromagnetic radiant energy through a portion of space or matter.

EventOntology.label: Email Messaging
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which digital messages are transmitted and received via Internet Message Format-based communication, or an extension thereof, over a computer network.
parents: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact

EventOntology.label: End of Life Stasis
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Artifact Operationality that holds during a Temporal Interval when the participating Material Artifact is no longer capable of realizing all of its designed primary Artifact Functions.

EventOntology.label: Enhanced Stasis
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant bears a Quality or Realizable Entity that has undergone improvement (i.e., an increase or gain) due to a previous action or event such that the Independent Continuant is now of greater value, usefulness, or functionality.

EventOntology.label: Extreme Ultraviolet Light Frequency
EventOntology.definition: An Ultraviolet Light Frequency that is between 3 and 30 petahertz.

EventOntology.label: Extremely High Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Microwave Frequency that is between 30 and 300 GHz.

EventOntology.label: Extremely Low Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 3 and 30 Hz.

EventOntology.label: FM Radio Broadcast Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Very High Frequency that is between 88 and 108 MHz.

EventOntology.label: Facsimile Transmission
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which a Document Content Entity is transmitted over a Telephone Network.
parents: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact

EventOntology.label: Far Infrared Light Frequency
EventOntology.definition: An Infrared Light Frequency that is between 300 gigahertz and 20 terahertz.

EventOntology.label: Fixed Line Network Telephone Call
EventOntology.definition: A Telephone Call transmitted over a telephone network where the telephones are wired into a single telephone exchange.

EventOntology.label: Force
EventOntology.definition: A Process Profile that is the rate of change of an object's Momentum, is the product of an object's Mass and Acceleration with respect to an inertial frame of reference, and is measured in units of Newtons (N).

EventOntology.label: Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Process Profile that is characterized by the number of repetitive processes during a particular time period.

EventOntology.label: Fundamental Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Sound Frequency that is the lowest Frequency of a Sound Wave.

EventOntology.label: Funeral
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Ceremony in which the Life of a Person who has died is celebrated, sanctified, or remembered.

EventOntology.label: Gain of Dependent Continuant
EventOntology.definition: A Change in which an Independent Continuant becomes the bearer or carrier of some Dependent Continuant.

EventOntology.label: Gain of Disposition
EventOntology.definition: A Gain of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant becomes the bearer of some Disposition.

EventOntology.label: Gain of Function
EventOntology.definition: A Gain of Disposition in which some Independent Continuant becomes the bearer of some Function.

EventOntology.label: Gain of Generically Dependent Continuant
EventOntology.definition: A Gain of Dependent Continuant wherein some Independent Continuant becomes the carrier of some Generically Dependent Continuant.

EventOntology.label: Gain of Quality
EventOntology.definition: A Gain of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which an Independent Continuant becomes the bearer of some Quality.

EventOntology.label: Gain of Realizable Entity
EventOntology.definition: A Gain of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant becomes the bearer of some Realizable Entity.

EventOntology.label: Gain of Role
EventOntology.definition: A Gain of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant becomes bearer of some Role.

EventOntology.label: Gain of Specifically Dependent Continuant
EventOntology.definition: A Gain of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant becomes the bearer of some Specifically Dependent Continuant.

EventOntology.label: Gamma Ray Frequency
EventOntology.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is above 30 exahertz.

EventOntology.label: Hard X-ray Frequency
EventOntology.definition: An X-Ray Frequency that is between 3 and 30 exahertz.

EventOntology.label: High Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 3 and 30 MHz.

EventOntology.label: Ignition Process
EventOntology.definition: A Natural Process that initiates a Combustion process.

EventOntology.label: Impulsive Force
EventOntology.definition: A Process Profile that is the integral of a Force that is applied to a portion of matter over a period of time.

EventOntology.label: Increase of Dependent Continuant
EventOntology.definition: A Change in which some Independent Continuant has an increase in the level of some Dependent Continuant that it bears.

EventOntology.label: Increase of Disposition
EventOntology.definition: An Increase of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Disposition that it bears.

EventOntology.label: Increase of Function
EventOntology.definition: An Increase of Disposition in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Function that it bears.

EventOntology.label: Increase of Generically Dependent Continuant
EventOntology.definition: An Increase of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Generically Dependent Continuant that it bears.

EventOntology.label: Increase of Quality
EventOntology.definition: An Increase of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Indpendent Continuant has an increase of some Quality that it bears.

EventOntology.label: Increase of Realizable Entity
EventOntology.definition: An Increase of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Realizable Entity that it bears.

EventOntology.label: Increase of Role
EventOntology.definition: An Increase of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Role that it bears.

EventOntology.label: Increase of Specifically Dependent Continuant
EventOntology.definition: An Increase of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Specifically Dependent Continuant that it bears.

EventOntology.label: Infrared Light Frequency
EventOntology.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 300 gigahertz and 430 tetrahertz.

EventOntology.label: Infrasonic Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Sound Frequency that is below 20 Hz.

EventOntology.label: Instant Messaging
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which real-time direct text-based communication occurs between two or more Agents using personal computers or other devices, along with shared Instant Messaging Client Software conveyed over a computer network.
parents: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact

EventOntology.label: Inverse Sawtooth Waveform
EventOntology.definition: A Waveform that is characterized by a sawtooth shape due to the continuous linear transition from maximum to minimum Amplitudes followed by a near-instantaneous transition from the minimum to maximum Amplitudes of the Wave Cycle.

EventOntology.label: Legal System Act
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act performed by an Agent that realizes their role within the context of a legal system of some jurisdiction.

EventOntology.label: Longitudinal Wave Profile
EventOntology.definition: A Wave Process Profile in which the displacement of participating particles is parallel to the direction of the Wave Process' propogation such that the particles alternate between participating in processes of compression and rarefaction as they participate in individual Wave Processes.

EventOntology.label: Loss of Dependent Continuant
EventOntology.definition: A Change in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer or carrier of some Dependent Continuant.

EventOntology.label: Loss of Disposition
EventOntology.definition: A Loss of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Disposition.

EventOntology.label: Loss of Function
EventOntology.definition: A Loss of Disposition in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Function.

EventOntology.label: Loss of Generically Dependent Continuant
EventOntology.definition: A Loss of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the carrier of some Generically Dependent Continuant.

EventOntology.label: Loss of Quality
EventOntology.definition: A Loss of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Quality.

EventOntology.label: Loss of Realizable Entity
EventOntology.definition: A Loss of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Realizable Entity.

EventOntology.label: Loss of Role
EventOntology.definition: A Loss of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Role.

EventOntology.label: Loss of Specifically Dependent Continuant
EventOntology.definition: A Loss of Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant ceases to be the bearer of some Specifically Dependent Continuant.

EventOntology.label: Loudness
EventOntology.definition: A Sound Process Profile that is characterized by the amplitude and total energy of translated sound waves, typically on a continuum from soft to loud.

EventOntology.label: Low Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 30 and 300 kHz.

EventOntology.label: Low Midrange Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 250 and 500 Hz.

EventOntology.label: Mailing
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Communication by Media in which information concretized in tangible objects, usually written documents, are delivered to recipients.
parents: Act of Communication by Movement of Information Bearing Artifact

EventOntology.label: Married
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Generically Dependent Continuant that consists of a socially, culturally, or ritually recognized union or legal contract between spouses that establishes rights and obligations between them, between them and their children, and between them and their in-laws.

EventOntology.label: Maximum Power
EventOntology.definition: A Power that is characterized by the maximum rate of Work, or Energy consumed, done in a given time period.

EventOntology.label: Mechanical Process
EventOntology.definition: A Process that is the realization of some Disposition of a Material Artifact.

EventOntology.label: Mechanical Wave Process
EventOntology.definition: A Wave Process that involves Oscillation of a portion of matter such that energy is transferred through the material medium.

EventOntology.label: Medium Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 300 kHz and 3 MHz.

EventOntology.label: Microwave Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 300 MHz and 300 GHz.

EventOntology.label: Mid Infrared Light Frequency
EventOntology.definition: An Infrared Light Frequency that is between 20 and 214 terahertz.

EventOntology.label: Midrange Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 500 Hz and 2 kHz.

EventOntology.label: Momentum
EventOntology.definition: A Process Profile of an object in Motion that is the product of its Mass and Velocity with respect to a frame of reference.

EventOntology.label: Motion
EventOntology.definition: A Natural Process in which a Continuant changes its Location or Spatial Orientation over some Temporal Interval.

EventOntology.label: Muzzle Blast
EventOntology.definition: A Sound Wave Process that is caused by a projectile being pushed from the barrel of a firearm by an explosive charge.

EventOntology.label: Natural Process
EventOntology.definition: A Process existing in or produced by nature; rather than by the intent of human beings.

EventOntology.label: Near Infrared Light Frequency
EventOntology.definition: An Infrared Light Frequency that is between 214 and 400 terahertz.

EventOntology.label: Near Ultraviolet Light Frequency
EventOntology.definition: An Ultraviolet Light Frequency that is between 750 terahertz and 3 petahertz.

EventOntology.label: Nominal Stasis
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant bears a Quality or Realizable Entity that has a level of intensity or functionality that falls within the designed, expected, or acceptable range such that the Independent Continuant is of normal value, usefulness, or functionality.

EventOntology.label: Operational Stasis
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Artifact Operationality that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact maintains its designed set of Artifact Functions (or at least maintains its primary functions).

EventOntology.label: Oscillation Process
EventOntology.definition: A Change in which the dependent entity alternates between two or more stases.

EventOntology.label: Pitch
EventOntology.definition: A Sound Process Profile that is characterized by the frequency of translated sound waves, typically on a continuum from low to high.

EventOntology.label: Planned Act
EventOntology.definition: An Act in which at least one Agent plays a causative role and which is prescribed by some Directive Information Content Entity held by at least one of the Agents.

EventOntology.label: Power
EventOntology.definition: A Process Profile that is characterized by the rate of Work, or Energy consumed, done in a given time period.

EventOntology.label: Presence Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 4 and 6 kHz.

EventOntology.label: Pressure
EventOntology.definition: A Force that is applied perpendicular to the surface of an Object per unit area over which that Force is distributed.

EventOntology.label: Private Network Telephone Call
EventOntology.definition: A Telephone Call transmitted over a network where a closed group of telephones are connected primarily to each other and use a gateway to reach the outside world.

EventOntology.label: Process Beginning
EventOntology.definition: A Process Boundary that occupies a Zero-Dimensional Temporal Region that is the starting instant of the One-Dimensional Temporal Region that the Process, of which the Process Boundary is a part, occupies.

EventOntology.label: Process Ending
EventOntology.definition: A Process Boundary that occupies a Zero-Dimensional Temporal Region that is the ending instant of the One-Dimensional Temporal Region that the Process, of which the Process Boundary is a part, occupies.

EventOntology.label: Process Profile
EventOntology.definition: An occurrent that is an occurrent part of some process by virtue of the rate, or pattern, or magnitude of change in an attribute of one or more participants of said process.

EventOntology.label: Proper Acceleration
EventOntology.definition: An Acceleration of an object relative to a free-fall, or inertial, observer who is momentarily at rest relative to the object being measured (hence, gravity does not cause Proper Acceleration).

EventOntology.label: Propulsion Process
EventOntology.definition: A Natural Process in which one or more Forces are generated and applied to a participating Object such that the Object is set in Motion or has the direction or magnitude of its Motion altered.

EventOntology.label: Radio Broadcast
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which communication with an audience is mediated through radio waves transmitted through a radio network.
parents: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact

EventOntology.label: Radio Frequency
EventOntology.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 3 kHz and 300 GHz.

EventOntology.label: Radio Interference
EventOntology.definition: A Natural Process in which a radio signal is disrupted, whether unintentionally or as the result of an Act of Radio Jamming, Act of Radio Spoofing, or similar Planned Act.

EventOntology.label: Rectilinear Motion
EventOntology.definition: A Translational Motion process in which an Object moves along a straight path.

EventOntology.label: Revolving Motion
EventOntology.definition: A Rotational Motion of an Object around an Axis of Rotation that is located externally to the Site occupied by the Object.

EventOntology.label: Rotational Motion
EventOntology.definition: A Motion Process in which an Object moves in a Circular or Elliptical Path around an Axis of Rotation.

EventOntology.label: Sawtooth Waveform
