EventOntology.definition: A Waveform that is characterized by a sawtooth shape due to the continuous linear transition from minimum to maximum Amplitudes followed by a near-instantaneous transition from the maximum to minimum Amplitudes of the Wave Cycle.

EventOntology.label: Shear Wave Process
EventOntology.definition: A Mechanical Wave that has a Transverse Wave Profile.

EventOntology.label: Sine Waveform
EventOntology.definition: A Waveform that is characterized by a smooth curved shape due to the continuous non-linear transitions between minimum and maximum Amplitudes of the Wave Cycle.

EventOntology.label: Social Act
EventOntology.definition: A Planned Act having an objective that affects, is performed by, or is performed on behalf of, a community or group of Persons.

EventOntology.label: Soft X-ray Frequency
EventOntology.definition: An X-Ray Frequency that is between 30 petahertz and 3 exahertz.

EventOntology.label: Sonic Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Sound Frequency that is between 20 Hz and 20 kHz.

EventOntology.label: Sound Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Frequency that is the rate of Oscillations per second of a Sound Wave.

EventOntology.label: Sound Pressure
EventOntology.definition: A Pressure that is caused by a Sound Wave and is a local deviation from the ambient Pressure.

EventOntology.label: Sound Process Profile
EventOntology.definition: A Process Profile that is part of a sound reception process and is characterized by properties of incoming sound waves as they are translated by some sensory system.

EventOntology.label: Sound Production
EventOntology.definition: A Wave Production Process that produces a Sound Wave.

EventOntology.label: Sound Wave Process
EventOntology.definition: A Mechanical Wave Process of Pressure and displacement that is parallel to the propogation direction of the Wave Process through a medium.

EventOntology.label: Sound Wavelength
EventOntology.definition: A Wavelength that is the distance a Sound Wave traverses during one Wave Cycle.

EventOntology.label: Speed
EventOntology.definition: A Process Profile that is characterized by the magnitude of an object's motion with respect to a frame of reference during some time period.

EventOntology.label: Spinning Motion
EventOntology.definition: A Rotational Motion of an Object around an Axis of Rotation that passes through the Object's Center of Mass.

EventOntology.label: Square Waveform
EventOntology.definition: A Waveform that is characterized by a square shape due to the near-instantaneous transitions between minimum and maximum Amplitudes of the Wave Cycle.

EventOntology.label: Stable Orientation
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Quality that holds during a Temporal Interval when an object maintains the same Spatial Orientation.

EventOntology.label: Stasis
EventOntology.definition: A Process in which one or more Independent Continuants endure in an unchanging condition.

EventOntology.label: Stasis of Artifact Operationality
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Realizable Entity that holds during a Temporal Interval when a Material Artifact's designed set of Artifact Functions (or at least its primary functions) or the realizations of those functions remain unchanged.

EventOntology.label: Stasis of Disposition
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant bears some Disposition that remains unchanged during a Temporal Interval.

EventOntology.label: Stasis of Fully Mission Capable
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Mission Capability during which the participating Continuant is capable of performing all of its primary functions for the specified Mission.

EventOntology.label: Stasis of Function
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant bears some Function that remains unchanged during a Temporal Interval.

EventOntology.label: Stasis of Generically Dependent Continuant
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis in which some Independent Continuant bears some Generically Dependent Continuant that remains unchanged during a Temporal Interval.

EventOntology.label: Stasis of Mission Capability
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Realizable Entity that holds during a temporal interval when a Continuant's capability (or lack thereof) to perform its intended Functions, tasks, or Objectives remains at a relatively constant level.

EventOntology.label: Stasis of Non-Mission Capable
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Mission Capability during which the participating Continuant is not capable of performing any of its primary functions for the specified Mission.

EventOntology.label: Stasis of Non-Mission Capable Maintenance
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Non-Mission Capable during which the participating Continuant is not capable of performing its primary functions for the specified Mission due to participating in an Act Of Maintenance.

EventOntology.label: Stasis of Partially Mission Capable
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Mission Capability during which the participating Continuant is capable of performing some but not all of its primary functions for the specified Mission.

EventOntology.label: Stasis of Partially Mission Capable Maintenance
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Partially Mission Capable during which the participating Continuant is not capable of performing some of its primary functions for the specified Mission due to participating in an Act Of Maintenance.

EventOntology.label: Stasis of Quality
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant bears some Quality that remains unchanged during a Temporal Interval.

EventOntology.label: Stasis of Realizable Entity
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Specifically Dependent Continuant in which some Independent Continuant bears some Realizable Entity that remains unchanged during a Temporal Interval.

EventOntology.label: Stasis of Role
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant bears some Role that remains unchanged during a Temporal Interval.

EventOntology.label: Stasis of Specifically Dependent Continuant
EventOntology.definition: A Stasis in which some Independent Continuant bears some Specifically Dependent Continuant that remains unchanged during a Temporal Interval.

EventOntology.label: Sub-Bass Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 20 and 60 Hz.

EventOntology.label: Super High Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Microwave Frequency that is between 3 and 30 GHz.

EventOntology.label: Super Low Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 30 and 300 Hz.

EventOntology.label: Surface Wave Profile
EventOntology.definition: A Wave Process Profile in which the Wave Process propogates along the surface of a medium and which involves both transverse and longitudinal wave profiles such that the motion of the displacement of participating particles is circular or elliptical.

EventOntology.label: Target
EventOntology.definition: A Material Entity that is the object of an Act of Targeting.

EventOntology.label: Telemetry Process
EventOntology.definition: A Mechanical Process that is highly automated and in which measurements are made or other data is collected and transmitted to receiving equipment to facilitate the monitoring of environmental conditions or equipment parameters at a remote or inaccessible location.

EventOntology.label: Telephone Call
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which sound is used to communicate over a telephone network to one or more recipients.
parents: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact

EventOntology.label: Television Broadcast
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which communication with an audience occurs via transmissions through a television network.
parents: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact

EventOntology.label: Text Messaging
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which communication occurs through the exchange of brief written messages between fixed-line phone or mobile phone and fixed or portable devices over a network.
parents: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact

EventOntology.label: Thrust
EventOntology.definition: A Force that is equal in magnitude to but in the opposite direction of an exerted Force and which is used to describe the forward Force of a Jet or Rocket Engine in reaction to the Acceleration of its Reaction Mass in the opposite direction.

EventOntology.label: Timbre
EventOntology.definition: A Sound Process Profile that is characterized by the variation, spectrum, or envelope of translated sound waves, typically on a continuum from dull or dark to bright.

EventOntology.label: Torque
EventOntology.definition: A Force that is applied to an object in a direction that would tend to cause the object to rotate around an Axis of Rotation and is the rate of change of an object's Angular Momentum.

EventOntology.label: Translational Motion
EventOntology.definition: A Motion Process in which the participating Object changes its position from one portion of space to another.

EventOntology.label: Transverse Wave Profile
EventOntology.definition: A Wave Process Profile in which the displacement of participating particles is perpendicular to the direction of the Wave Process' propogation.

EventOntology.label: Tremendously High Frequency
EventOntology.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 300 GHz and 3 THz.

EventOntology.label: Triangular Waveform
EventOntology.definition: A Waveform that is characterized by a triangular shape due to the continuous linear zig-zag transitions between minimum and maximum Amplitudes of the Wave Cycle.

EventOntology.label: Ultra High Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Microwave Frequency that is between 300 MHz and 3 GHz.

EventOntology.label: Ultra Low Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 300 Hz and 3 kHz.

EventOntology.label: Ultrasonic Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Sound Frequency that is greater than 20 kHz.

EventOntology.label: Ultraviolet Light Frequency
EventOntology.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 750 terahertz and 30 petahertz.

EventOntology.label: Under Active Control
EventOntology.definition: An Active Stasis during which a Material Artifact participates in an Act of Artifact Employment.

EventOntology.label: Unplanned Act
EventOntology.definition: An Act in which at least one Agent plays a causative role and which is not prescribed by some Objective held by any of the Agents.

EventOntology.label: Upper Midrange Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Sonic Frequency that is between 2 and 4 kHz.

EventOntology.label: Velocity
EventOntology.definition: A Process Profile of an object's Motion that is characterized by its Speed and direction with respect to a frame of reference.

EventOntology.label: Very High Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 30 and 300 MHz.

EventOntology.label: Very Low Frequency
EventOntology.definition: A Radio Frequency that is between 3 and 30 kHz.

EventOntology.label: Vibration Motion
EventOntology.definition: A Motion wherein some participant repetitively deviates from a central location to two surrounding locations.

EventOntology.label: Visible Light Frequency
EventOntology.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 400 and 800 terahertz.

EventOntology.label: Visible Light Reflection Process
EventOntology.definition: A Wave Process in which an Electromagnetic Wave with a Visible Light Frequency is reflected off a portion of matter.

EventOntology.label: Visible Observation
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Observation that involves visual perception.

EventOntology.label: Wave Cycle
EventOntology.definition: A Wave Process that consists of a portion of a Wave Process that begins at an arbitrary point of the Wave Process and ends at the next point when the pattern of the Wave Process begins to repeat.

EventOntology.label: Wave Process
EventOntology.definition: A Natural Process that involves Oscillation accompanied by a transfer of energy that travels through a portion of matter or spatial region.

EventOntology.label: Wave Process Profile
EventOntology.definition: A Process Profile of a Wave Process.

EventOntology.label: Wave Production
EventOntology.definition: A Natural Process in which a Wave Process is generated.

EventOntology.label: Waveform
EventOntology.definition: A Wave Process Profile that is the shape of the Wave Cycles of the Wave Process when depicted in a visual graph.

EventOntology.label: Wavelength
EventOntology.definition: A Wave Process Profile that is the distance the Wave Process traverses during one Wave Cycle.

EventOntology.label: Webcast
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact in which communication with an audience occurs over the Internet using streaming media technology to distribute a single content source that may be distributed live or on demand.
parents: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact

EventOntology.label: Wedding
EventOntology.definition: An Act of Ceremony in which two Persons are united in Marriage or a similar institution.

EventOntology.label: Wireless Network Telephone Call
EventOntology.definition: A Telephone Call transmitted over a network where the telephones are not dependent on a physical connection to the network such that they can continue to operate anywhere within the coverage area.

EventOntology.label: Wounded Stasis
EventOntology.definition: A Damaged Stasis in which a Person or other organism is the bearer of a Quality or Realizable Entity that has suffered impairment (i.e., a decrease or loss) due to an injuring event.

EventOntology.label: X-ray Frequency
EventOntology.definition: An Electromagnetic Radiation Frequency of some Electromagnetic Wave that is between 30 petahertz and 30 exahertz.

BFO-2020-core.label: continuant
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A continuant is an entity that persists, endures, or continues to exist through time while maintaining its identity

BFO-2020-core.label: continuant fiat boundary
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A continuant fiat boundary b is an immaterial entity that is of zero, one or two dimensions & such that there is no time t when b has a spatial region as continuant part & whose location is determined in relation to some material entity

BFO-2020-core.label: disposition
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A disposition b is a realizable entity such that if b ceases to exist then its bearer is physically changed & b's realization occurs when and because this bearer is in some special physical circumstances & this realization occurs in virtue of the bearer's physical make-up

BFO-2020-core.label: entity
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) An entity is anything that exists or has existed or will exist

BFO-2020-core.label: fiat line
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A fiat line is a one-dimensional continuant fiat boundary that is continuous

BFO-2020-core.label: fiat object part
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A fiat object part b is a material entity & such that if b exists then it is continuant part of some object c & demarcated from the remainder of c by one or more fiat surfaces

BFO-2020-core.label: fiat point
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A fiat point is a zero-dimensional continuant fiat boundary that consists of a single point

BFO-2020-core.label: fiat surface
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A fiat surface is a two-dimensional continuant fiat boundary that is self-connected

BFO-2020-core.label: function
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A function is a disposition that exists in virtue of its bearer's physical make-up & this physical make-up is something the bearer possesses because it came into being either through evolution (in the case of natural biological entities) or through intentional design (in the case of artefacts) in order to realize processes of a certain sort

BFO-2020-core.label: generically dependent continuant
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A generically dependent continuant is an entity that exists in virtue of the fact that there is at least one of what may be multiple copies which is the content or the pattern that multiple copies would share

BFO-2020-core.label: history
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A history is a process that is the sum of the totality of processes taking place in the spatiotemporal region occupied by the material part of a material entity

BFO-2020-core.label: immaterial entity
BFO-2020-core.definition: b is an immaterial entity =Def b is an independent continuant which is such that there is no time t when it has a material entity as continuant part

BFO-2020-core.label: independent continuant
BFO-2020-core.definition: b is an independent continuant =Def b is a continuant & there is no c such that b specifically depends on c or b generically depends on c

BFO-2020-core.label: material entity
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A material entity is an independent continuant has some portion of matter as continuant part

BFO-2020-core.label: object
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) An object is a material entity which manifests causal unity & is of a type instances of which are maximal relative to the sort of causal unity manifested

BFO-2020-core.label: object aggregate
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) An object aggregate is a material entity consisting exactly of a plurality (≥1) of objects as member parts which together form a unit

BFO-2020-core.label: occurrent
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) An occurrent is an entity that unfolds itself in time or it is the start or end of such an entity or it is a temporal or spatiotemporal region

BFO-2020-core.label: one-dimensional spatial region
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A one-dimensional spatial region is a whole consisting of a line together with zero or more lines which may have points as parts

BFO-2020-core.label: one-dimensional temporal region
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A one-dimensional temporal region is a temporal region that is a whole that has a temporal interval and zero or more temporal intervals and temporal instants as parts

BFO-2020-core.label: process
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) p is a process means p is an occurrent that has some temporal proper part and for some time t, p has some material entity as participant

BFO-2020-core.label: process boundary
BFO-2020-core.definition: p is a process boundary =Def p is a temporal part of a process & p has no proper temporal parts

BFO-2020-core.label: quality
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A quality is a specifically dependent continuant that, in contrast to roles and dispositions, does not require any further process in order to be realized

BFO-2020-core.label: realizable entity
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A realizable entity is a specifically dependent continuant that inheres in some independent continuant which is not a spatial region & which is of a type some instances of which are realized in processes of a correlated type

BFO-2020-core.label: relational quality
BFO-2020-core.definition: b is a relational quality =Def b is a quality & there exists c and d such that c and d are not identical & b specifically depends on c & b specifically depends on d

BFO-2020-core.label: role
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A role b is a realizable entity such that b exists because there is some single bearer that is in some special physical, social, or institutional set of circumstances in which this bearer does not have to be & b is not such that, if it ceases to exist, then the physical make-up of the bearer is thereby changed

BFO-2020-core.label: site
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A site is a three-dimensional immaterial entity whose boundaries either (partially or wholly) coincide with the boundaries of one or more material entities or have locations determined in relation to some material entity

BFO-2020-core.label: spatial region
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A spatial region is a continuant entity that is a continuant part of the spatial projection of a portion of spacetime at a given time

BFO-2020-core.label: spatiotemporal region
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A spatiotemporal region is an occurrent that is an occurrent part of spacetime

BFO-2020-core.label: specifically dependent continuant
BFO-2020-core.definition: b is a specifically dependent continuant =Def b is a continuant & there is some independent continuant c which is not a spatial region & which is such that b specifically depends on c

BFO-2020-core.label: temporal instant
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A temporal instant is a zero-dimensional temporal region that has no proper temporal part

BFO-2020-core.label: temporal interval
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A temporal interval is a one-dimensional temporal region that is continuous, thus without gaps or breaks

BFO-2020-core.label: temporal region
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A temporal region is an occurrent over which processes can unfold

BFO-2020-core.label: three-dimensional spatial region
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A three-dimensional spatial region is a whole consisting of a spatial volume together with zero or more spatial volumes which may have spatial regions of lower dimension as parts

BFO-2020-core.label: two-dimensional spatial region
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A two-dimensional spatial region is a spatial region that is a whole consisting of a surface together with zero or more surfaces which may have spatial regions of lower dimension as parts

BFO-2020-core.label: zero-dimensional spatial region
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A zero-dimensional spatial region is one or a collection of more than one spatially disjoint points in space

BFO-2020-core.label: zero-dimensional temporal region
BFO-2020-core.definition: (Elucidation) A zero-dimensional temporal region is a temporal region that is a whole consisting of one or more separated temporal instants as parts
